decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.applyMulAction
decls.doc: The tautological action of the self-diffeomorphism group on the manifold by evaluation.
decls.statement: instance applyMulAction : MulAction (M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) M

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.smul_def
decls.doc: The tautological action of `M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M` on `M` is given by evaluation.
decls.statement: theorem smul_def (f : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) (x : M) : f • x = f x

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.toPermHom_eq_toPerm
decls.doc:
The action homomorphism of the tautological diffeomorphism action is the forgetful homomorphism
to permutations.
decls.statement:
theorem toPermHom_eq_toPerm :
    MulAction.toPermHom (M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) M = toPerm

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.applyFaithfulSMul
decls.doc: The tautological action of `M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M` on `M` is faithful.
decls.statement: instance applyFaithfulSMul : FaithfulSMul (M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) M

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.applyContinuousConstSMul
decls.doc: The action of each self-diffeomorphism on `M` is continuous.
decls.statement: instance applyContinuousConstSMul : ContinuousConstSMul (M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) M

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.applySubgroupContinuousConstSMul
decls.doc:
A subgroup of the self-diffeomorphism group acts continuously on `M` in the point, by the
generic subgroup transfer for `ContinuousConstSMul`.
decls.statement:
abbrev applySubgroupContinuousConstSMul (G : Subgroup (M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M)) :
    ContinuousConstSMul G M

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.diffCongr
decls.doc:
Conjugation by a diffeomorphism `e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N` as a group isomorphism between the
self-diffeomorphism groups: `diffCongr e φ = e ∘ φ ∘ e⁻¹`. This is the diffeomorphism analogue of
`Equiv.permCongr` and expresses that diffeomorphic manifolds have isomorphic self-diffeomorphism
groups.
decls.statement: def diffCongr (e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N) : (M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) ≃* (N ≃ₘ^n⟮J, J⟯ N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.diffCongr_apply_apply
decls.doc: The conjugating isomorphism acts pointwise by `diffCongr e φ x = e (φ (e.symm x))`.
decls.statement:
theorem diffCongr_apply_apply (e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N) (φ : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) (x : N) :
    diffCongr e φ x = e (φ (e.symm x))

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.diffCongr_apply
decls.doc: The underlying diffeomorphism of `diffCongr e φ` is `e ∘ φ ∘ e⁻¹`.
decls.statement:
theorem diffCongr_apply (e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N) (φ : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) :
    diffCongr e φ = (e.symm.trans φ).trans e

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.diffCongr_inv
decls.doc: The inverse of `diffCongr e φ` is `diffCongr e φ⁻¹`, since conjugation is a homomorphism.
decls.statement:
theorem diffCongr_inv (e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N) (φ : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) :
    (diffCongr e φ)⁻¹ = diffCongr e φ⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.diffCongr_refl
decls.doc: Conjugating by the identity diffeomorphism is the identity isomorphism.
decls.statement:
theorem diffCongr_refl :
    diffCongr (_root_.Diffeomorph.refl I M n) = MulEquiv.refl (M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.diffCongr_trans
decls.doc:
Conjugation is functorial: conjugating by a composite diffeomorphism is the composite of the
conjugating isomorphisms.
decls.statement:
theorem diffCongr_trans (e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N) (e' : N ≃ₘ^n⟮J, K⟯ P) :
    diffCongr (e.trans e') = (diffCongr e).trans (diffCongr e')

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.diffCongr_symm
decls.doc: The isomorphism conjugating by `e.symm` is the inverse of the one conjugating by `e`.
decls.statement: theorem diffCongr_symm (e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N) : (diffCongr e).symm = diffCongr e.symm

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.toHomeomorphHom_comp_diffCongr
decls.doc:
Naturality of `diffCongr` against the forgetful homomorphism to self-homeomorphisms, as a
commutative square of group homomorphisms: conjugating diffeomorphisms by `e` and then forgetting
smoothness equals forgetting smoothness and then conjugating homeomorphisms by `e` through
`Homeomorph.homeoCongr`. This is the naturality of `diffCongr` against the stronger forgetful
homomorphism `Diffeomorph.toHomeomorphHom`, refining `toPerm_comp_diffCongr`.
decls.statement:
theorem toHomeomorphHom_comp_diffCongr (e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N) :
    toHomeomorphHom.comp (diffCongr e).toMonoidHom =
      (Homeomorph.homeoCongr e.toHomeomorph).toMonoidHom.comp toHomeomorphHom

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.toPerm_comp_diffCongr
decls.doc:
Naturality of `diffCongr` against the forgetful homomorphism to permutations, as a commutative
square of group homomorphisms intertwining `diffCongr` with `Equiv.permCongrHom`; this is the
`toPerm`-level shadow of `toHomeomorphHom_comp_diffCongr`.
decls.statement:
theorem toPerm_comp_diffCongr (e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N) :
    toPerm.comp (diffCongr e).toMonoidHom = e.toEquiv.permCongrHom.toMonoidHom.comp toPerm

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.toHomeomorph_diffCongr
decls.doc:
Forgetting only smoothness (keeping the topology) sends `diffCongr e φ` to the conjugate of
underlying self-homeomorphisms `e ∘ φ ∘ e⁻¹`; the elementwise shadow of
`toHomeomorphHom_comp_diffCongr`.
decls.statement:
theorem toHomeomorph_diffCongr (e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N) (φ : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) :
    (diffCongr e φ).toHomeomorph =
      (e.toHomeomorph.symm.trans φ.toHomeomorph).trans e.toHomeomorph

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.toPerm_diffCongr
decls.doc:
Forgetting all topology intertwines `diffCongr` with `Equiv.permCongr` on the permutation
groups; the elementwise shadow of `toPerm_comp_diffCongr`.
decls.statement:
theorem toPerm_diffCongr (e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N) (φ : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) :
    toPerm (diffCongr e φ) = e.toEquiv.permCongr (toPerm φ)

decls.name: TauCeti.RelativeDiff
decls.doc: The relative diffeomorphism group fixing the subset `s` pointwise.
decls.statement:
abbrev RelativeDiff (I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H) (M : Type*) [TopologicalSpace M]
    [ChartedSpace H M] (n : ℕ∞ω) (s : Set M) : Type _

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.fixingSubgroup
decls.doc:
The subgroup of self-diffeomorphisms fixing every point of `s`.

This is Mathlib's generic `fixingSubgroup`, specialized to the tautological action of
`M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M` on `M`. For a boundary set this is the algebraic part of the relative
diffeomorphism group `Diff(M, ∂M)`.
decls.statement: abbrev fixingSubgroup (s : Set M) : Subgroup (M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff
decls.doc: Membership in the pointwise fixing subgroup is the pointwise fixedness equation on `s`.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_fixingSubgroup_iff {s : Set M} {f : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M} :
    f ∈ fixingSubgroup (I := I) (n := n) s ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, f x = x

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.apply_eq_of_mem_fixingSubgroup
decls.doc: A member of `fixingSubgroup s` fixes each point of `s`.
decls.statement:
theorem apply_eq_of_mem_fixingSubgroup {s : Set M} {f : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M}
    (hf : f ∈ fixingSubgroup (I := I) (n := n) s) {x : M} (hx : x ∈ s) : f x = x

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.mem_fixingSubgroup_of_forall
decls.doc:
To prove that a diffeomorphism lies in the pointwise fixing subgroup, prove it fixes each
point of the subset.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_fixingSubgroup_of_forall {s : Set M} {f : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M}
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ s, f x = x) : f ∈ fixingSubgroup (I := I) (n := n) s

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.fixingSubgroup_empty
decls.doc: The relative diffeomorphism group fixing the empty set is the full diffeomorphism group.
decls.statement:
theorem fixingSubgroup_empty :
    fixingSubgroup (I := I) (M := M) (n := n) (∅ : Set M) = ⊤

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.fixingSubgroup_univ
decls.doc: The relative diffeomorphism group fixing all points is trivial.
decls.statement:
theorem fixingSubgroup_univ :
    fixingSubgroup (I := I) (M := M) (n := n) (Set.univ : Set M) = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.fixingSubgroup_antitone
decls.doc: Fixing a larger set pointwise gives a smaller subgroup.
decls.statement:
theorem fixingSubgroup_antitone {s t : Set M} (hst : s ⊆ t) :
    fixingSubgroup (I := I) (n := n) t ≤ fixingSubgroup (I := I) (n := n) s

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.fixingSubgroup_congr
decls.doc: Pointwise fixing is invariant under replacing the subset by an equal subset.
decls.statement:
theorem fixingSubgroup_congr {s t : Set M} (hst : s = t) :
    fixingSubgroup (I := I) (n := n) s = fixingSubgroup (I := I) (n := n) t

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.fixingSubgroup_le_stabilizer
decls.doc: The pointwise fixer of a subset is contained in its setwise stabilizer.
decls.statement:
theorem fixingSubgroup_le_stabilizer (s : Set M) :
    fixingSubgroup (I := I) (n := n) s ≤
      MulAction.stabilizer (M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) s

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.fixingSubgroup_union
decls.doc: Fixing `s ∪ t` pointwise is the same as fixing both `s` and `t` pointwise.
decls.statement:
theorem fixingSubgroup_union (s t : Set M) :
    fixingSubgroup (I := I) (n := n) (s ∪ t) =
      fixingSubgroup (I := I) (n := n) s ⊓ fixingSubgroup (I := I) (n := n) t

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.toHomeomorph_mem_fixingSubgroup
decls.doc:
The forgetful homomorphism to homeomorphisms sends a relative diffeomorphism to a homeomorphism
fixing the same subset pointwise.

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.toRelativeHomeomorphHom
decls.doc:
Forgetting smoothness maps the relative diffeomorphism group into the corresponding relative
homeomorphism group.

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.toRelativeHomeomorphHom_apply
decls.doc:
Applying the forgetful homomorphism to a relative diffeomorphism is its underlying
homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
theorem toRelativeHomeomorphHom_apply (s : Set M)
    (f : fixingSubgroup (I := I) (n := n) s) :
    (toRelativeHomeomorphHom (M := M) s f : M ≃ₜ M) =
      (f : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M).toHomeomorph

decls.name: TauCeti.RelativeDiff.apply_eq
decls.doc: A relative diffeomorphism fixes every point of the subset defining it.

decls.name: TauCeti.RelativeDiff.continuousConstSMul
decls.doc: The relative diffeomorphism group inherits pointwise continuity of its action on `M`.
decls.statement:
abbrev RelativeDiff.continuousConstSMul (s : Set M) :
    ContinuousConstSMul (RelativeDiff (𝕜 := 𝕜) (I := I) M n s) M

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.instOne
decls.doc: The identity diffeomorphism is the unit of the self-diffeomorphism group.
decls.statement: instance instOne : One (M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.instMul
decls.doc:
Multiplication of self-diffeomorphisms is composition: `f * g` follows `g` then `f`, so that it
acts as `f ∘ g`, matching the `Equiv.Perm` convention.
decls.statement: instance instMul : Mul (M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.instInv
decls.doc: The inverse in the self-diffeomorphism group is the inverse diffeomorphism.
decls.statement: instance instInv : Inv (M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.trans_assoc
decls.doc: Composition of diffeomorphisms is associative.
decls.statement:
theorem trans_assoc
    {E' : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E']
    {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F]
    {F' : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F']
    {H' : Type*} [TopologicalSpace H'] {G : Type*} [TopologicalSpace G]
    {G' : Type*} [TopologicalSpace G']
    {I' : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E' H'} {J : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 F G}
    {J' : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 F' G'}
    {M' : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M'] [ChartedSpace H' M']
    {N : Type*} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace G N]
    {N' : Type*} [TopologicalSpace N'] [ChartedSpace G' N']
    (f : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I'⟯ M') (g : M' ≃ₘ^n⟮I', J⟯ N)
    (h : N ≃ₘ^n⟮J, J'⟯ N') :
    (f.trans g).trans h = f.trans (g.trans h)

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.instGroup
decls.doc:
The `Cⁿ` self-diffeomorphisms of `M` form a group under composition, with multiplication
acting as function composition.
decls.statement: instance instGroup : Group (M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.one_def
decls.doc: The unit of the self-diffeomorphism group is the identity diffeomorphism.
decls.statement: theorem one_def : (1 : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) = _root_.Diffeomorph.refl I M n

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.mul_def
decls.doc: Multiplication in the self-diffeomorphism group is `Diffeomorph.trans` in composition order.
decls.statement: theorem mul_def (f g : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) : f * g = g.trans f

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.inv_def
decls.doc: Inversion in the self-diffeomorphism group is the inverse diffeomorphism.
decls.statement: theorem inv_def (f : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) : f⁻¹ = f.symm

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.coe_one
decls.doc: The unit self-diffeomorphism coerces to the identity function.
decls.statement: theorem coe_one : ⇑(1 : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) = id

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.coe_mul
decls.doc: Multiplication of self-diffeomorphisms coerces to function composition.
decls.statement: theorem coe_mul (f g : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) : ⇑(f * g) = f ∘ g

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.coe_inv
decls.doc: The inverse self-diffeomorphism coerces to the inverse diffeomorphism.
decls.statement: theorem coe_inv (f : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) : ⇑(f⁻¹) = f.symm

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.mul_apply
decls.doc: Multiplication of self-diffeomorphisms acts by applying the right factor, then the left.
decls.statement: theorem mul_apply (f g : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) (x : M) : (f * g) x = f (g x)

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.one_apply
decls.doc: The unit self-diffeomorphism fixes every point.
decls.statement: theorem one_apply (x : M) : (1 : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) x = x

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.inv_apply
decls.doc: The inverse in the self-diffeomorphism group acts as the inverse diffeomorphism.
decls.statement: theorem inv_apply (f : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) (x : M) : f⁻¹ x = f.symm x

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.toEquiv_one
decls.doc: The underlying equivalence of the unit self-diffeomorphism is the unit permutation.
decls.statement: theorem toEquiv_one : (1 : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M).toEquiv = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.toEquiv_mul
decls.doc: The underlying equivalence preserves multiplication of self-diffeomorphisms.
decls.statement: theorem toEquiv_mul (f g : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) : (f * g).toEquiv = f.toEquiv * g.toEquiv

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.toEquiv_inv
decls.doc: The underlying equivalence preserves inversion of self-diffeomorphisms.
decls.statement: theorem toEquiv_inv (f : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) : (f⁻¹).toEquiv = f.toEquiv⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.toPerm
decls.doc:
The forgetful group homomorphism from the self-diffeomorphism group to the permutation group of
the underlying set, sending a diffeomorphism to its underlying equivalence.
decls.statement: def toPerm : (M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) →* Equiv.Perm M

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.toPerm_injective
decls.doc: The forgetful homomorphism to permutations is injective.
decls.statement: theorem toPerm_injective : Function.Injective (toPerm : (M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) → Equiv.Perm M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.toHomeomorphHom
decls.doc: The forgetful group homomorphism from self-diffeomorphisms to self-homeomorphisms.
decls.statement: def toHomeomorphHom : (M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) →* (M ≃ₜ M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.toHomeomorphHom_apply
decls.doc:
The forgetful homomorphism to self-homeomorphisms sends a diffeomorphism to its underlying
homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
theorem toHomeomorphHom_apply (f : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) :
    toHomeomorphHom f = f.toHomeomorph

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.toHomeomorphHom_injective
decls.doc: The forgetful homomorphism to self-homeomorphisms is injective.
decls.statement:
theorem toHomeomorphHom_injective :
    Function.Injective (toHomeomorphHom : (M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) → (M ≃ₜ M))

decls.name: TauCeti.Diff
decls.doc:
`Diff I M n` is the group of `Cⁿ` self-diffeomorphisms of the manifold `M` modelled on `I`,
under composition. With `n = ∞` this is the group underlying `Diff(M)` of the geometric-topology
roadmap.
decls.statement:
abbrev Diff (I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H) (M : Type*) [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M]
    (n : ℕ∞ω) : Type _

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.map_fixingSubgroup_diffCongr
decls.doc:
Conjugation by `e` maps the subgroup fixing `s` pointwise onto the subgroup fixing `e '' s`
pointwise.
decls.statement:
theorem map_fixingSubgroup_diffCongr (e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N) (s : Set M) :
    (fixingSubgroup (I := I) (n := n) s).map (diffCongr e).toMonoidHom =
      fixingSubgroup (I := J) (n := n) (e '' s)

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.map_fixingSubgroup_diffCongr_of_image_eq
decls.doc:
Conjugation by `e` maps the subgroup fixing `s` pointwise onto the subgroup fixing a named
target `t` pointwise, when `t` is the image of `s`.
decls.statement:
theorem map_fixingSubgroup_diffCongr_of_image_eq (e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N) {s : Set M} {t : Set N}
    (hst : e '' s = t) :
    (fixingSubgroup (I := I) (n := n) s).map (diffCongr e).toMonoidHom =
      fixingSubgroup (I := J) (n := n) t

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.diffCongr_mem_fixingSubgroup_image
decls.doc:
Conjugating by `e` sends diffeomorphisms fixing `s` pointwise to diffeomorphisms fixing
`e '' s` pointwise.

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.diffCongr_symm_mem_fixingSubgroup
decls.doc:
Conjugating by `e.symm` sends diffeomorphisms fixing `e '' s` pointwise back to
diffeomorphisms fixing `s` pointwise.

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.relativeDiffCongrOfImageEq
decls.doc:
Conjugation by a diffeomorphism identifies the relative diffeomorphism group fixing `s`
pointwise with the relative diffeomorphism group fixing a named target `t` pointwise, when `t` is
the image of `s`.
decls.statement:
def relativeDiffCongrOfImageEq (e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N) {s : Set M} {t : Set N}
    (hst : e '' s = t) :
    fixingSubgroup (I := I) (n := n) s ≃*
      fixingSubgroup (I := J) (n := n) t

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.relativeDiffCongr
decls.doc:
Conjugation by a diffeomorphism identifies the relative diffeomorphism group fixing `s`
pointwise with the relative diffeomorphism group fixing the image subset `e '' s` pointwise.

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.relativeDiffCongrOfImageEq_apply
decls.doc:
Applying `relativeDiffCongrOfImageEq` and then forgetting the subgroup is
`Diffeomorph.diffCongr`.

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.relativeDiffCongr_apply
decls.doc: Applying `relativeDiffCongr` and then forgetting the subgroup is `Diffeomorph.diffCongr`.
decls.statement:
theorem relativeDiffCongr_apply (e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N) (s : Set M)
    (φ : fixingSubgroup (I := I) (n := n) s) :
    (relativeDiffCongr e s φ : N ≃ₘ^n⟮J, J⟯ N) = diffCongr e φ

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.relativeDiffCongrOfImageEq_apply_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise formula for the named-target relative conjugation equivalence.
decls.statement:
theorem relativeDiffCongrOfImageEq_apply_apply (e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N) {s : Set M} {t : Set N}
    (hst : e '' s = t) (φ : fixingSubgroup (I := I) (n := n) s) (y : N) :
    ((relativeDiffCongrOfImageEq e hst φ : N ≃ₘ^n⟮J, J⟯ N) y) =
      e ((φ : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) (e.symm y))

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.relativeDiffCongr_apply_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise formula for the relative conjugation equivalence.
decls.statement:
theorem relativeDiffCongr_apply_apply (e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N) (s : Set M)
    (φ : fixingSubgroup (I := I) (n := n) s) (y : N) :
    ((relativeDiffCongr e s φ : N ≃ₘ^n⟮J, J⟯ N) y) =
      e ((φ : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) (e.symm y))

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.relativeDiffCongrOfImageEq_symm_apply
decls.doc:
Applying the inverse of `relativeDiffCongrOfImageEq` and then forgetting the subgroup is
conjugation by `e.symm`.

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.relativeDiffCongr_symm_apply
decls.doc:
Applying the inverse of `relativeDiffCongr` and then forgetting the subgroup is conjugation by
`e.symm`.
decls.statement:
theorem relativeDiffCongr_symm_apply (e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N) (s : Set M)
    (ψ : fixingSubgroup (I := J) (n := n) (e '' s)) :
    ((relativeDiffCongr e s).symm ψ : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) = diffCongr e.symm ψ

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.relativeDiffCongrOfImageEq_symm_apply_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise formula for the inverse named-target relative conjugation equivalence.
decls.statement:
theorem relativeDiffCongrOfImageEq_symm_apply_apply (e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N)
    {s : Set M} {t : Set N} (hst : e '' s = t)
    (ψ : fixingSubgroup (I := J) (n := n) t) (x : M) :
    (((relativeDiffCongrOfImageEq e hst).symm ψ : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) x) =
      e.symm ((ψ : N ≃ₘ^n⟮J, J⟯ N) (e x))

decls.name: TauCeti.Diffeomorph.relativeDiffCongr_symm_apply_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise formula for the inverse relative conjugation equivalence.
decls.statement:
theorem relativeDiffCongr_symm_apply_apply (e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N) (s : Set M)
    (ψ : fixingSubgroup (I := J) (n := n) (e '' s)) (x : M) :
    (((relativeDiffCongr e s).symm ψ : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) x) =
      e.symm ((ψ : N ≃ₘ^n⟮J, J⟯ N) (e x))

decls.name: TauCeti.LinearIsometryEquiv.contMDiff_unitSphereEquiv
decls.doc:
The restriction of a linear isometry equivalence to the unit sphere is `C^m`, for every
smoothness exponent `m`.
decls.statement:
theorem contMDiff_unitSphereEquiv (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) :
    ContMDiff (𝓡 n) (𝓡 k) m (unitSphereEquiv e)

decls.name: TauCeti.LinearIsometryEquiv.unitSphereDiffeomorph
decls.doc: The diffeomorphism between unit spheres induced by a linear isometry equivalence.
decls.statement:
def unitSphereDiffeomorph (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) (m : ℕ∞ω) :
    sphere (0 : E) 1 ≃ₘ^m⟮𝓡 n, 𝓡 k⟯ sphere (0 : F) 1

decls.name: TauCeti.LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_unitSphereDiffeomorph_apply
decls.statement:
theorem coe_unitSphereDiffeomorph_apply (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) (x : sphere (0 : E) 1) :
    ((unitSphereDiffeomorph (n := n) (k := k) e m x : sphere (0 : F) 1) : F) = e x

decls.name: TauCeti.LinearIsometryEquiv.unitSphereDiffeomorph_toEquiv
decls.statement:
theorem unitSphereDiffeomorph_toEquiv (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) :
    (unitSphereDiffeomorph (n := n) (k := k) e m).toEquiv = unitSphereEquiv e

decls.name: TauCeti.LinearIsometryEquiv.unitSphereDiffeomorph_symm
decls.statement:
theorem unitSphereDiffeomorph_symm (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) :
    (unitSphereDiffeomorph (n := n) (k := k) e m).symm =
      unitSphereDiffeomorph (n := k) (k := n) e.symm m

decls.name: TauCeti.LinearIsometryEquiv.unitSphereDiffeomorph_neg_apply
decls.doc:
The antipodal map of the unit sphere is the diffeomorphism induced by `-1`, the element of
`O(n + 1)` given by `LinearIsometryEquiv.neg`. In particular Mathlib's `contMDiff_neg_sphere` is
the case `e = -1` of `contMDiff_unitSphereEquiv`.
decls.statement:
theorem unitSphereDiffeomorph_neg_apply (x : sphere (0 : E) 1) :
    unitSphereDiffeomorph (n := n) (k := n) (_root_.LinearIsometryEquiv.neg ℝ) m x = -x

decls.name: TauCeti.LinearIsometryEquiv.unitSphereDiffHom
decls.doc:
The inclusion of the linear isometry group of `E` into the group of self-diffeomorphisms of
its unit sphere. For `E = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))` this is the reference inclusion
`O(n + 1) → Diff(Sⁿ)`; see `TauCeti.orthogonalToDiffSphere`.
decls.statement:
def unitSphereDiffHom (m : ℕ∞ω) :
    (E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) →* Diff (𝓡 n) (sphere (0 : E) 1) m

decls.name: TauCeti.LinearIsometryEquiv.unitSphereDiffHom_apply
decls.statement:
theorem unitSphereDiffHom_apply (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) :
    unitSphereDiffHom (E := E) (n := n) m e = unitSphereDiffeomorph e m

decls.name: TauCeti.LinearIsometryEquiv.unitSphereDiffHom_injective
decls.doc:
The inclusion of the linear isometry group into the diffeomorphism group of the unit sphere is
injective, so `O(n + 1)` is realised as a subgroup of `Diff(Sⁿ)`.
decls.statement:
theorem unitSphereDiffHom_injective :
    Function.Injective (unitSphereDiffHom (E := E) (n := n) m)

decls.name: TauCeti.orthogonalToDiffSphere
decls.doc:
The reference inclusion `O(n + 1) → Diff(Sⁿ)`: an orthogonal transformation of `ℝⁿ⁺¹`
restricts to a diffeomorphism of the unit sphere `Sⁿ`, and this restriction is a group
homomorphism. It is injective by `TauCeti.orthogonalToDiffSphere_injective`.

decls.name: TauCeti.orthogonalToDiffSphere_apply
decls.doc:
The reference inclusion `O(n + 1) → Diff(Sⁿ)` sends an orthogonal transformation to its
restriction to the unit sphere.
decls.statement:
theorem orthogonalToDiffSphere_apply (n : ℕ) (m : ℕ∞ω)
    (A : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) :
    orthogonalToDiffSphere n m A =
      LinearIsometryEquiv.unitSphereDiffHom m (orthogonalGroupToLinearIsometryEquiv A)

decls.name: TauCeti.orthogonalToDiffSphere_injective
decls.doc:
The reference inclusion `O(n + 1) → Diff(Sⁿ)` is injective, so `O(n + 1)` is realised as a
subgroup of `Diff(Sⁿ)`.
decls.statement:
theorem orthogonalToDiffSphere_injective (n : ℕ) (m : ℕ∞ω) :
    Function.Injective (orthogonalToDiffSphere n m)

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding
decls.doc:
A bundled `C^n` smooth embedding between manifolds.

This is a bundled `ContMDiffMap` whose underlying function satisfies Mathlib's
`Manifold.IsSmoothEmbedding`: it is both a `C^n` immersion and a topological embedding.
decls.statement:
structure SmoothEmbedding (I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H) (J : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E' H')
    (n : ℕ∞ω) (M : Type*) [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M]
    (N : Type*) [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace H' N]

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.instFunLike
decls.statement: instance instFunLike : FunLike (SmoothEmbedding I J n M N) M N

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.instContinuousMapClass
decls.statement: instance instContinuousMapClass : ContinuousMapClass (SmoothEmbedding I J n M N) M N

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.toContMDiffMap_coe
decls.doc: The bundled `C^n` map underlying a smooth embedding.
decls.statement:
theorem toContMDiffMap_coe (f : SmoothEmbedding I J n M N) :
    ⇑f.toContMDiffMap = f

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.toContinuousMap
decls.doc: The continuous map underlying a bundled smooth embedding.
decls.statement: abbrev toContinuousMap (f : SmoothEmbedding I J n M N) : C(M, N)

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.toContinuousMap_apply
decls.statement:
theorem toContinuousMap_apply (f : SmoothEmbedding I J n M N) (x : M) :
    f.toContinuousMap x = f x

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.coe_toContinuousMap
decls.statement:
theorem coe_toContinuousMap (f : SmoothEmbedding I J n M N) :
    ⇑f.toContinuousMap = f

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.toContinuousMap_injective
decls.doc: The underlying continuous map determines a bundled smooth embedding.
decls.statement:
theorem toContinuousMap_injective :
    Function.Injective (toContinuousMap : SmoothEmbedding I J n M N → C(M, N))

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.toContinuousMap_inj
decls.statement:
theorem toContinuousMap_inj {f g : SmoothEmbedding I J n M N} :
    (toContinuousMap f : C(M, N)) = toContinuousMap g ↔ f = g

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.contMDiff
decls.doc: A bundled smooth embedding is a `C^n` map.
decls.statement: theorem contMDiff (f : SmoothEmbedding I J n M N) : ContMDiff I J n f

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.isSmoothEmbedding
decls.doc: A bundled smooth embedding satisfies Mathlib's smooth-embedding predicate.
decls.statement:
theorem isSmoothEmbedding (f : SmoothEmbedding I J n M N) :
    Manifold.IsSmoothEmbedding I J n f

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.isImmersion
decls.doc: A bundled smooth embedding is an immersion.
decls.statement: theorem isImmersion (f : SmoothEmbedding I J n M N) : Manifold.IsImmersion I J n f

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.isEmbedding
decls.doc: A bundled smooth embedding is a topological embedding.
decls.statement: theorem isEmbedding (f : SmoothEmbedding I J n M N) : IsEmbedding f

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ofIsSmoothEmbedding
decls.doc: Bundle a map satisfying Mathlib's smooth-embedding predicate as a smooth embedding.
decls.statement:
def ofIsSmoothEmbedding (f : M → N) (hf : Manifold.IsSmoothEmbedding I J n f) :
    SmoothEmbedding I J n M N

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ofIsSmoothEmbedding_coe
decls.statement:
theorem ofIsSmoothEmbedding_coe (f : M → N) (hf : Manifold.IsSmoothEmbedding I J n f) :
    ⇑(ofIsSmoothEmbedding (I := I) (J := J) (n := n) f hf) = f

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ofIsSmoothEmbedding_apply
decls.statement:
theorem ofIsSmoothEmbedding_apply (f : M → N) (hf : Manifold.IsSmoothEmbedding I J n f) (x : M) :
    ofIsSmoothEmbedding (I := I) (J := J) (n := n) f hf x = f x

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ext
decls.doc: Two smooth embeddings are equal when their underlying functions are pointwise equal.
decls.statement: theorem ext (h : ∀ x, f x = g x) : f = g

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.id
decls.doc: The identity map as a bundled smooth embedding.
decls.statement: def id [IsManifold I n M] : SmoothEmbedding I I n M M

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.id_apply
decls.statement:
theorem id_apply [IsManifold I n M] (x : M) :
    (id (I := I) (n := n) (M := M)) x = x

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.id_coe
decls.statement:
theorem id_coe [IsManifold I n M] :
    ⇑(id (I := I) (n := n) (M := M)) = _root_.id

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.of_opens
decls.doc: The inclusion of an open subset of a manifold as a bundled smooth embedding.
decls.statement:
def of_opens [IsManifold I n M] (s : TopologicalSpace.Opens M) :
    SmoothEmbedding I I n s M

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.of_opens_apply
decls.statement:
theorem of_opens_apply [IsManifold I n M] (s : TopologicalSpace.Opens M) (x : s) :
    of_opens (I := I) (n := n) s x = x

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.of_opens_coe
decls.statement:
theorem of_opens_coe [IsManifold I n M] (s : TopologicalSpace.Opens M) :
    ⇑(of_opens (I := I) (n := n) s) = Subtype.val

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.prodMap
decls.doc: The product of two bundled smooth embeddings.
decls.statement:
def prodMap [IsManifold I n M] [IsManifold J n N]
    [IsManifold I' n M'] [IsManifold J' n N']
    (f : SmoothEmbedding I J n M N) (g : SmoothEmbedding I' J' n M' N') :
    SmoothEmbedding (I.prod I') (J.prod J') n (M × M') (N × N')

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.prodMap_apply
decls.statement:
theorem prodMap_apply [IsManifold I n M] [IsManifold J n N]
    [IsManifold I' n M'] [IsManifold J' n N']
    (f : SmoothEmbedding I J n M N) (g : SmoothEmbedding I' J' n M' N') (x : M × M') :
    f.prodMap g x = (f x.1, g x.2)

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.prodMap_coe
decls.statement:
theorem prodMap_coe [IsManifold I n M] [IsManifold J n N]
    [IsManifold I' n M'] [IsManifold J' n N']
    (f : SmoothEmbedding I J n M N) (g : SmoothEmbedding I' J' n M' N') :
    ⇑(f.prodMap g) = fun x => (f x.1, g x.2)

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.toContinuousMap_prodMap
decls.doc:
The underlying continuous map of a product of smooth embeddings is the product of the
underlying continuous maps.
decls.statement:
theorem toContinuousMap_prodMap [IsManifold I n M] [IsManifold J n N]
    [IsManifold I' n M'] [IsManifold J' n N']
    (f : SmoothEmbedding I J n M N) (g : SmoothEmbedding I' J' n M' N') :
    (f.prodMap g).toContinuousMap = f.toContinuousMap.prodMap g.toContinuousMap

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.sumInl
decls.doc: The left coproduct inclusion as a bundled smooth embedding.
decls.statement:
def sumInl {M₂ : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M₂] [ChartedSpace H M₂]
    [IsManifold I n M] [IsManifold I n M₂] :
    SmoothEmbedding I I n M (M ⊕ M₂)

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.sumInl_apply
decls.statement:
theorem sumInl_apply {M₂ : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M₂] [ChartedSpace H M₂]
    [IsManifold I n M] [IsManifold I n M₂] (x : M) :
    (sumInl (I := I) (n := n) (M := M) (M₂ := M₂)) x = Sum.inl x

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.sumInl_coe
decls.statement:
theorem sumInl_coe {M₂ : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M₂] [ChartedSpace H M₂]
    [IsManifold I n M] [IsManifold I n M₂] :
    ⇑(sumInl (I := I) (n := n) (M := M) (M₂ := M₂)) = Sum.inl

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.sumInr
decls.doc: The right coproduct inclusion as a bundled smooth embedding.
decls.statement:
def sumInr {M₂ : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M₂] [ChartedSpace H M₂]
    [IsManifold I n M] [IsManifold I n M₂] :
    SmoothEmbedding I I n M₂ (M ⊕ M₂)

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.sumInr_apply
decls.statement:
theorem sumInr_apply {M₂ : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M₂] [ChartedSpace H M₂]
    [IsManifold I n M] [IsManifold I n M₂] (x : M₂) :
    (sumInr (I := I) (n := n) (M := M) (M₂ := M₂)) x = Sum.inr x

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.sumInr_coe
decls.statement:
theorem sumInr_coe {M₂ : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M₂] [ChartedSpace H M₂]
    [IsManifold I n M] [IsManifold I n M₂] :
    ⇑(sumInr (I := I) (n := n) (M := M) (M₂ := M₂)) = Sum.inr

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ContinuousAmbientIsotopic
decls.doc:
Two bundled smooth embeddings are continuously ambient isotopic when their underlying
continuous maps are ambient isotopic. This is the continuous topological relation, not a smooth
ambient isotopy.
decls.statement: def ContinuousAmbientIsotopic (f g : SmoothEmbedding I J n M N) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.continuousAmbientIsotopic_def
decls.doc:
Continuous ambient isotopy of bundled smooth embeddings is witnessed by an ambient isotopy
whose final homeomorphism postcomposes the first underlying continuous map to the second.
decls.statement:
theorem continuousAmbientIsotopic_def :
    ContinuousAmbientIsotopic f g ↔
      ∃ Φ : TauCeti.AmbientIsotopy N, Φ.final.comp f.toContinuousMap = g.toContinuousMap

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ContinuousAmbientIsotopic.of_ambientIsotopy
decls.doc:
An ambient isotopy whose final map carries `f` to `g` witnesses continuous ambient isotopy of
the two bundled smooth embeddings.
decls.statement:
theorem of_ambientIsotopy (Φ : TauCeti.AmbientIsotopy N)
    (hΦ : Φ.final.comp f.toContinuousMap = g.toContinuousMap) : ContinuousAmbientIsotopic f g

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ContinuousAmbientIsotopic.of_eq_final_comp
decls.doc:
A symmetric form of `SmoothEmbedding.ContinuousAmbientIsotopic.of_ambientIsotopy`, useful when
the endpoint equation is oriented as `g = Φ.final ∘ f`.
decls.statement:
theorem of_eq_final_comp (Φ : TauCeti.AmbientIsotopy N)
    (hΦ : g.toContinuousMap = Φ.final.comp f.toContinuousMap) : ContinuousAmbientIsotopic f g

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ContinuousAmbientIsotopic.refl
decls.doc: Continuous ambient isotopy of bundled smooth embeddings is reflexive.
decls.statement: theorem refl (f : SmoothEmbedding I J n M N) : ContinuousAmbientIsotopic f f

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ContinuousAmbientIsotopic.symm
decls.doc: Continuous ambient isotopy of bundled smooth embeddings is symmetric.
decls.statement: theorem symm (hfg : ContinuousAmbientIsotopic f g) : ContinuousAmbientIsotopic g f

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ContinuousAmbientIsotopic.trans
decls.doc: Continuous ambient isotopy of bundled smooth embeddings is transitive.
decls.statement:
theorem trans (hfg : ContinuousAmbientIsotopic f g) (hgh : ContinuousAmbientIsotopic g h) :
    ContinuousAmbientIsotopic f h

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ContinuousAmbientIsotopic.isotopic
decls.doc:
Continuously ambient isotopic bundled smooth embeddings have isotopic underlying continuous
maps.
decls.statement:
theorem isotopic (hfg : ContinuousAmbientIsotopic f g) :
    Isotopic f.toContinuousMap g.toContinuousMap

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ContinuousAmbientIsotopic.equivalence
decls.doc: Continuous ambient isotopy is an equivalence relation on bundled smooth embeddings.
decls.statement:
theorem equivalence :
    Equivalence (ContinuousAmbientIsotopic (I := I) (J := J) (n := n) (M := M) (N := N))

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ContinuousAmbientIsotopic.setoid
decls.doc:
The continuous-ambient-isotopy equivalence relation on bundled smooth embeddings, packaged as
a `Setoid`.
decls.statement:
def setoid (I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H) (J : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E' H') (n : ℕ∞ω)
    (M : Type*) [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M]
    (N : Type*) [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace H' N] :
    Setoid (SmoothEmbedding I J n M N)

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ContinuousAmbientIsotopic.setoid_r_iff
decls.statement:
theorem setoid_r_iff {f g : SmoothEmbedding I J n M N} :
    (setoid I J n M N).r f g ↔ ContinuousAmbientIsotopic f g

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ContinuousAmbientIsotopic.of_toContinuousMap_eq
decls.doc:
Continuous ambient isotopy of bundled smooth embeddings is insensitive to replacing both
endpoints by bundled embeddings with the same underlying continuous maps.
decls.statement:
theorem of_toContinuousMap_eq (hfg : ContinuousAmbientIsotopic f g)
    [ChartedSpace K M] [ChartedSpace K' N]
    {f' g' : SmoothEmbedding I' J' n' M N}
    (hf' : f'.toContinuousMap = f.toContinuousMap)
    (hg' : g'.toContinuousMap = g.toContinuousMap) :
    ContinuousAmbientIsotopic f' g'

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ContinuousAmbientIsotopic.iff_of_toContinuousMap_eq
decls.doc:
Continuous ambient isotopy of bundled smooth embeddings can be checked on the underlying
continuous maps. This is useful when the endpoint maps have been rewritten by a construction
outside the bundled smooth-embedding API.
decls.statement:
theorem iff_of_toContinuousMap_eq
    [ChartedSpace K M] [ChartedSpace K' N]
    {f' g' : SmoothEmbedding I' J' n' M N}
    (hf' : f'.toContinuousMap = f.toContinuousMap)
    (hg' : g'.toContinuousMap = g.toContinuousMap) :
    ContinuousAmbientIsotopic f' g' ↔ ContinuousAmbientIsotopic f g

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ContinuousAmbientIsotopic.precomp_of_toContinuousMap_eq
decls.doc:
Precomposing both endpoints by a continuous source map preserves continuous ambient isotopy,
provided the precomposed maps have already been bundled as smooth embeddings.
decls.statement:
theorem precomp_of_toContinuousMap_eq (hfg : ContinuousAmbientIsotopic f g) (e : C(M', M))
    [ChartedSpace L' N]
    {f₁ g₁ : SmoothEmbedding I' J'' n' M' N}
    (hf₁ : f₁.toContinuousMap = f.toContinuousMap.comp e)
    (hg₁ : g₁.toContinuousMap = g.toContinuousMap.comp e) :
    ContinuousAmbientIsotopic f₁ g₁

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ContinuousAmbientIsotopic.postcomp_homeomorph_of_toContinuousMap_eq
decls.doc:
Postcomposing both endpoints by a homeomorphism of ambient spaces preserves continuous
ambient isotopy, provided the postcomposed maps have already been bundled as smooth embeddings.
decls.statement:
theorem postcomp_homeomorph_of_toContinuousMap_eq (hfg : ContinuousAmbientIsotopic f g)
    (h : N ≃ₜ N')
    [ChartedSpace L M]
    {f₂ g₂ : SmoothEmbedding I'' J' n' M N'}
    (hf₂ : f₂.toContinuousMap = (h : C(N, N')).comp f.toContinuousMap)
    (hg₂ : g₂.toContinuousMap = (h : C(N, N')).comp g.toContinuousMap) :
    ContinuousAmbientIsotopic f₂ g₂

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ContinuousAmbientIsotopic.postcomp_homeomorph_precomp_of_toContinuousMap_eq
decls.doc:
The two-sided coordinate-change form: precompose the source by a continuous map and
postcompose the ambient space by a homeomorphism, with the resulting endpoint maps supplied as
already-bundled smooth embeddings.
decls.statement:
theorem postcomp_homeomorph_precomp_of_toContinuousMap_eq
    (hfg : ContinuousAmbientIsotopic f g) (h : N ≃ₜ N') (e : C(M', M))
    {f₃ g₃ : SmoothEmbedding I' J' n' M' N'}
    (hf₃ : f₃.toContinuousMap = (h : C(N, N')).comp (f.toContinuousMap.comp e))
    (hg₃ : g₃.toContinuousMap = (h : C(N, N')).comp (g.toContinuousMap.comp e)) :
    ContinuousAmbientIsotopic f₃ g₃

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ContinuousAmbientIsotopic.prodMap
decls.doc:
Products preserve continuous ambient isotopy of bundled smooth embeddings.

If `f` is continuously ambient isotopic to `f'` and `g` is continuously ambient isotopic to `g'`,
then the bundled product embedding `f.prodMap g` is continuously ambient isotopic to
`f'.prodMap g'`. This is the smooth-embedding specialisation of
`TauCeti.AmbientIsotopic.prodMap`.
decls.statement:
theorem prodMap (hff' : ContinuousAmbientIsotopic f f') (hgg' : ContinuousAmbientIsotopic g g') :
    ContinuousAmbientIsotopic (f.prodMap g) (f'.prodMap g')

decls.name: TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.ContinuousAmbientIsotopic.prodMap_setoid
decls.doc: Product closure for the continuous-ambient-isotopy setoid on bundled smooth embeddings.
decls.statement:
theorem prodMap_setoid
    (hff' : (setoid I₁ J₁ n M₁ N₁).r f f')
    (hgg' : (setoid I₂ J₂ n M₂ N₂).r g g') :
    (setoid (I₁.prod I₂) (J₁.prod J₂) n (M₁ × M₂) (N₁ × N₂)).r
      (f.prodMap g) (f'.prodMap g')

decls.name: TauCeti.LinearIsometryEquiv.map_mem_unitSphere_iff
decls.doc:
A linear isometry equivalence preserves the unit sphere: it maps unit vectors to unit vectors,
and nothing else to unit vectors.
decls.statement:
theorem map_mem_unitSphere_iff (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[R] F) (x : E) :
    e x ∈ sphere (0 : F) 1 ↔ x ∈ sphere (0 : E) 1

decls.name: TauCeti.LinearIsometryEquiv.unitSphereEquiv
decls.doc: A linear isometry equivalence restricts to an equivalence of the corresponding unit spheres.
decls.statement: def unitSphereEquiv (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[R] F) : sphere (0 : E) 1 ≃ sphere (0 : F) 1

decls.name: TauCeti.LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_unitSphereEquiv_apply
decls.statement:
theorem coe_unitSphereEquiv_apply (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[R] F) (x : sphere (0 : E) 1) :
    (unitSphereEquiv e x : F) = e x

decls.name: TauCeti.LinearIsometryEquiv.unitSphereEquiv_symm
decls.statement:
theorem unitSphereEquiv_symm (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[R] F) :
    (unitSphereEquiv e).symm = unitSphereEquiv e.symm

decls.name: TauCeti.LinearIsometryEquiv.unitSphereEquiv_refl
decls.statement:
theorem unitSphereEquiv_refl :
    unitSphereEquiv (_root_.LinearIsometryEquiv.refl R E) = Equiv.refl (sphere (0 : E) 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.LinearIsometryEquiv.unitSphereEquiv_trans
decls.statement:
theorem unitSphereEquiv_trans (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[R] F) (e' : F ≃ₗᵢ[R] G) :
    unitSphereEquiv (e.trans e') = (unitSphereEquiv e).trans (unitSphereEquiv e')

decls.name: TauCeti.LinearIsometryEquiv.isometry_unitSphereEquiv
decls.doc:
The restriction of a linear isometry equivalence to the unit sphere is an isometry for the
distance the sphere inherits from `E`: the action of `O(n + 1)` on `Sⁿ` is by isometries of the
round sphere.
decls.statement: theorem isometry_unitSphereEquiv (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[R] F) : Isometry (unitSphereEquiv e)

decls.name: TauCeti.LinearMap.eq_of_eqOn_unitSphere
decls.doc:
A real linear map is determined by its values on the unit sphere, since every nonzero vector
is a positive multiple of a unit vector.
decls.statement:
theorem eq_of_eqOn_unitSphere {f g : E →ₗ[ℝ] F} (h : Set.EqOn f g (sphere (0 : E) 1)) :
    f = g

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure
decls.doc:
A pointwise almost complex structure is a real-linear endomorphism whose square is `-1`.

This is the fiberwise object underlying an almost complex structure on a real vector bundle or
manifold. Smoothness is deliberately not bundled here; the analytic roadmap needs the linear
algebra separately on each tangent space.
decls.statement: structure AlmostComplexStructure (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.toLinearMap_injective
decls.doc:
The underlying linear map determines an almost complex structure: the only data is the
endomorphism, the defining identity being a proposition.
decls.statement:
theorem toLinearMap_injective :
    Function.Injective (toLinearMap : AlmostComplexStructure V → (V →ₗ[ℝ] V))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.instCoeFunForall
decls.statement: instance : CoeFun (AlmostComplexStructure V) fun _ => V → V

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.apply_apply
decls.doc: Applying `J` twice gives `-v`.
decls.statement: lemma apply_apply (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) (v : V) : J (J v) = -v

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.injective
decls.doc: The underlying linear map of an almost complex structure is injective.
decls.statement: lemma injective (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) : Function.Injective J

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.surjective
decls.doc: The underlying linear map of an almost complex structure is surjective.
decls.statement: lemma surjective (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) : Function.Surjective J

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.linearEquiv
decls.doc:
The linear equivalence attached to an almost complex structure.

Its inverse is `-J`; this is often the convenient way to move bilinear-form statements across
`J`.
decls.statement: def linearEquiv (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] V

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.linearEquiv_apply
decls.statement:
lemma linearEquiv_apply (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) (v : V) :
    J.linearEquiv v = J v

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.linearEquiv_symm_apply
decls.statement:
lemma linearEquiv_symm_apply (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) (v : V) :
    J.linearEquiv.symm v = -J v

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.map_eq_zero_iff
decls.statement:
lemma map_eq_zero_iff (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) {v : V} :
    J v = 0 ↔ v = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.map_ne_zero_iff
decls.statement:
lemma map_ne_zero_iff (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) {v : V} :
    J v ≠ 0 ↔ v ≠ 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.ext
decls.doc: Two almost complex structures agreeing pointwise are equal.
decls.statement: lemma ext {J K : AlmostComplexStructure V} (h : ∀ v, J v = K v) : J = K

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.neg
decls.doc: The negation of an almost complex structure is again an almost complex structure.
decls.statement: def neg (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) : AlmostComplexStructure V

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.instNeg
decls.statement: instance : Neg (AlmostComplexStructure V)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.neg_toLinearMap
decls.statement:
lemma neg_toLinearMap (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) :
    (-J).toLinearMap = -J.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.neg_apply
decls.statement:
lemma neg_apply (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) (v : V) :
    (-J) v = -J v

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.product
decls.doc: The standard almost complex structure on `V × V`, sending `(x, y)` to `(-y, x)`.
decls.statement:
def product (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] :
    AlmostComplexStructure (V × V)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.product_apply
decls.statement:
lemma product_apply (v : V × V) :
    product V v = (-v.2, v.1)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsComplexLinearMap
decls.doc:
A real-linear map is complex-linear with respect to two fixed pointwise
almost complex structures if it intertwines them.
decls.statement:
def IsComplexLinearMap (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) (J' : AlmostComplexStructure W)
    (F : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.isComplexLinearMap_iff_isComplexLinear
decls.doc:
The bundled almost-complex predicate is the raw complex-linearity predicate applied to the
underlying endomorphisms.
decls.statement:
lemma isComplexLinearMap_iff_isComplexLinear (J : AlmostComplexStructure V)
    (J' : AlmostComplexStructure W) (F : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) :
    IsComplexLinearMap J J' F ↔ IsComplexLinear J.toLinearMap J'.toLinearMap F

decls.name: TauCeti.isComplexLinearMap_iff_apply
decls.doc:
Rewrite complex-linearity of a real-linear map as the pointwise equation
`F (J v) = J' (F v)`.
decls.statement:
lemma isComplexLinearMap_iff_apply (J : AlmostComplexStructure V)
    (J' : AlmostComplexStructure W) (F : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) :
    IsComplexLinearMap J J' F ↔ ∀ v, F (J v) = J' (F v)

decls.name: TauCeti.isComplexLinearMap_iff_mem_complexLinearMaps
decls.doc:
Complex-linearity for almost complex structures is membership in the existing submodule of
raw-linear complex-linear maps.
decls.statement:
lemma isComplexLinearMap_iff_mem_complexLinearMaps (J : AlmostComplexStructure V)
    (J' : AlmostComplexStructure W) (F : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) :
    IsComplexLinearMap J J' F ↔ F ∈ complexLinearMaps J.toLinearMap J'.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.isComplexLinearMap_zero
decls.doc: The zero map is complex-linear for any source and target almost complex structures.
decls.statement:
lemma isComplexLinearMap_zero (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) (J' : AlmostComplexStructure W) :
    IsComplexLinearMap J J' (0 : V →ₗ[ℝ] W)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsComplexLinearMap.add
decls.doc: Complex-linear maps are closed under addition.

decls.name: TauCeti.IsComplexLinearMap.neg
decls.doc: Complex-linear maps are closed under negation.

decls.name: TauCeti.isComplexLinearMap_neg_iff
decls.doc: Negating a map preserves and reflects complex-linearity.

decls.name: TauCeti.IsComplexLinearMap.neg_neg
decls.doc:
Complex-linearity is unchanged after negating both the source and target almost complex
structures.

decls.name: TauCeti.IsComplexLinearMap.of_neg_neg
decls.doc:
If a map is complex-linear after negating both structures, then it was complex-linear before
the sign change.

decls.name: TauCeti.isComplexLinearMap_neg_neg_iff
decls.doc: Negating both almost complex structures leaves the complex-linearity condition unchanged.

decls.name: TauCeti.IsComplexLinearMap.sub
decls.doc: Complex-linear maps are closed under subtraction.

decls.name: TauCeti.IsComplexLinearMap.smul
decls.doc: Complex-linear maps are closed under real scalar multiplication.

decls.name: TauCeti.isComplexLinearMap_id
decls.doc: The identity map is complex-linear with respect to the same almost complex structure.
decls.statement:
lemma isComplexLinearMap_id (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) :
    IsComplexLinearMap J J (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[ℝ] V)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsComplexLinearMap.comp
decls.doc: Complex-linear maps are closed under composition.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.isComplexLinearMap_toLinearMap
decls.doc: An almost complex structure is complex-linear as a map from its module to itself.
decls.statement:
lemma AlmostComplexStructure.isComplexLinearMap_toLinearMap (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) :
    IsComplexLinearMap J J J.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.IsComplexLinearMap.comp_almostComplexStructure_toLinearMap
decls.doc:
Precomposing a complex-linear map by the source almost complex structure again gives a
complex-linear map.
decls.statement:
lemma IsComplexLinearMap.comp_almostComplexStructure_toLinearMap
    {J : AlmostComplexStructure V} {J' : AlmostComplexStructure W} {F : V →ₗ[ℝ] W}
    (hF : IsComplexLinearMap J J' F) :
    IsComplexLinearMap J J' (F.comp J.toLinearMap)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsComplexLinearMap.of_comp_almostComplexStructure_toLinearMap
decls.doc:
If precomposition by the source almost complex structure is complex-linear, then the original
map was complex-linear.
decls.statement:
lemma IsComplexLinearMap.of_comp_almostComplexStructure_toLinearMap
    {J : AlmostComplexStructure V} {J' : AlmostComplexStructure W} {F : V →ₗ[ℝ] W}
    (hF : IsComplexLinearMap J J' (F.comp J.toLinearMap)) :
    IsComplexLinearMap J J' F

decls.name: TauCeti.isComplexLinearMap_comp_almostComplexStructure_toLinearMap_iff
decls.doc:
Precomposition by the source almost complex structure preserves and reflects
complex-linearity.
decls.statement:
lemma isComplexLinearMap_comp_almostComplexStructure_toLinearMap_iff
    {J : AlmostComplexStructure V} {J' : AlmostComplexStructure W} {F : V →ₗ[ℝ] W} :
    IsComplexLinearMap J J' (F.comp J.toLinearMap) ↔ IsComplexLinearMap J J' F

decls.name: TauCeti.bilinForm_comp_almostComplexStructure
decls.doc:
The ordered pairing `B (F v) (F (J₀ v))` of an alternating bilinear form `B` is unchanged when
both arguments are precomposed by a source almost complex structure `J₀`: rotating the source by
`J₀` sends the pair `(v, J₀ v)` to `(J₀ v, -v)`, and alternation leaves the pairing unchanged.

Only alternation of `B` is used, so the statement lives at the `LinearMap.BilinForm` level; the
`SymplecticForm` corollary is `SymplecticForm.symplecticForm_comp_almostComplexStructure`.
decls.statement:
lemma bilinForm_comp_almostComplexStructure {U V : Type*} [AddCommGroup U] [Module ℝ U]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] {B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ V} (hB : B.IsAlt)
    (J₀ : AlmostComplexStructure U) (F : U →ₗ[ℝ] V) (v : U) :
    B ((F.comp J₀.toLinearMap) v) ((F.comp J₀.toLinearMap) (J₀ v)) = B (F v) (F (J₀ v))

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm
decls.doc:
A symplectic form on a real module is an alternating, nondegenerate bilinear form.

This is the pointwise linear-algebra notion. Closedness of a differential form belongs to the
manifold layer and is not bundled here.
decls.statement: structure SymplecticForm (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.toBilinForm_injective
decls.doc:
The underlying bilinear form determines a symplectic form: the only data is the form, the
alternating and nondegeneracy conditions being propositions.
decls.statement:
theorem toBilinForm_injective :
    Function.Injective (toBilinForm : SymplecticForm V → LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ V)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.instCoeFunForallForallReal
decls.statement: instance : CoeFun (SymplecticForm V) fun _ => V → V → ℝ

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.self_eq_zero
decls.doc: A symplectic form vanishes on the diagonal.
decls.statement: lemma self_eq_zero (ω : SymplecticForm V) (v : V) : ω v v = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.neg_eq
decls.doc: A symplectic form is skew-symmetric in the usual additive form.
decls.statement:
lemma neg_eq (ω : SymplecticForm V) (v w : V) :
    -ω v w = ω w v

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.symplecticForm_comp_almostComplexStructure
decls.doc:
The ordered area density `ω (F v) (F (J₀ v))` is unchanged when both arguments are
precomposed by a source almost complex structure `J₀`: rotating the source by `J₀` sends the
pair `(v, J₀ v)` to `(J₀ v, -v)`, which has the same symplectic area. This is the
`SymplecticForm` corollary of `bilinForm_comp_almostComplexStructure`.
decls.statement:
lemma symplecticForm_comp_almostComplexStructure {U : Type*} [AddCommGroup U] [Module ℝ U]
    (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J₀ : AlmostComplexStructure U) (F : U →ₗ[ℝ] V) (v : U) :
    ω ((F.comp J₀.toLinearMap) v) ((F.comp J₀.toLinearMap) (J₀ v)) = ω (F v) (F (J₀ v))

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isRefl
decls.doc: A symplectic form is reflexive as an orthogonality relation.
decls.statement: lemma isRefl (ω : SymplecticForm V) : ω.toBilinForm.IsRefl

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.separatingLeft
decls.doc: Nondegeneracy can be tested on the left variable for a symplectic form.
decls.statement:
lemma separatingLeft (ω : SymplecticForm V) :
    ω.toBilinForm.SeparatingLeft

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.separatingRight
decls.doc: Nondegeneracy can be tested on the right variable for a symplectic form.
decls.statement:
lemma separatingRight (ω : SymplecticForm V) :
    ω.toBilinForm.SeparatingRight

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.pullback
decls.doc: The bilinear form `ω(J ·, J ·)`.
decls.statement:
def pullback (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) :
    LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ V

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.pullback_apply
decls.statement:
lemma pullback_apply (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) (v w : V) :
    ω.pullback J v w = ω (J v) (J w)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Invariant
decls.doc: A symplectic form is `J`-invariant when `ω(Jv, Jw) = ω(v, w)`.
decls.statement: def Invariant (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.invariant_iff
decls.statement:
lemma invariant_iff (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) :
    ω.Invariant J ↔ ∀ v w, ω (J v) (J w) = ω v w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.associatedBilinForm
decls.doc: The bilinear form `g(v,w) = ω(v, Jw)` associated to `ω` and `J`.
decls.statement:
def associatedBilinForm (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) :
    LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ V

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.associatedBilinForm_apply
decls.statement:
lemma associatedBilinForm_apply
    (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) (v w : V) :
    ω.associatedBilinForm J v w = ω v (J w)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames
decls.doc: `ω` tames `J` if `ω(v, Jv)` is positive on every nonzero vector.
decls.statement: def Tames (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.tames_iff_associated_pos
decls.statement:
lemma tames_iff_associated_pos (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) :
    ω.Tames J ↔ (ω.associatedBilinForm J).toQuadraticMap.PosDef

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible
decls.doc: `ω` is compatible with `J` if it is `J`-invariant and `ω(·, J ·)` is positive definite.
decls.statement: structure Compatible (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.compatible_iff
decls.doc: Compatibility is equivalently `J`-invariance plus tameness.
decls.statement:
lemma compatible_iff (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) :
    ω.Compatible J ↔ ω.Invariant J ∧ ω.Tames J

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible.of_tames
decls.doc: Build compatibility from `J`-invariance and the named tameness predicate.
decls.statement:
lemma Compatible.of_tames {ω : SymplecticForm V} {J : AlmostComplexStructure V}
    (hinvariant : ω.Invariant J) (htames : ω.Tames J) : ω.Compatible J

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible.tames
decls.statement:
lemma Compatible.tames {ω : SymplecticForm V} {J : AlmostComplexStructure V}
    (h : ω.Compatible J) : ω.Tames J

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible.invariant_apply
decls.statement:
lemma Compatible.invariant_apply {ω : SymplecticForm V} {J : AlmostComplexStructure V}
    (h : ω.Compatible J) (v w : V) : ω (J v) (J w) = ω v w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Invariant.associatedBilinForm_apply_swap
decls.doc:
For a `J`-invariant form, the associated bilinear form is symmetric pointwise. Only invariance
is needed.

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible.associatedBilinForm_apply_swap
decls.doc: For a compatible pair, the associated bilinear form is symmetric pointwise.

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Invariant.associatedBilinForm_isSymm
decls.doc:
For a `J`-invariant form, the associated bilinear form `ω(·, J ·)` is symmetric. Only
invariance is needed.

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible.associatedBilinForm_isSymm
decls.doc: For a compatible pair, the associated bilinear form `ω(·, J ·)` is symmetric.

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.associatedBilinForm_apply_apply_self_eq
decls.doc:
Applying the almost complex structure to both entries preserves the diagonal of the
associated bilinear form.
decls.statement:
lemma associatedBilinForm_apply_apply_self_eq (ω : SymplecticForm V)
    (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) (v : V) :
    ω.associatedBilinForm J (J v) (J v) = ω.associatedBilinForm J v v

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible.associated_pos
decls.statement:
lemma Compatible.associated_pos {ω : SymplecticForm V} {J : AlmostComplexStructure V}
    (h : ω.Compatible J) {v : V} (hv : v ≠ 0) : 0 < ω v (J v)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsComplexLinearMap.associatedBilinForm_apply_apply_self_eq
decls.doc:
For a complex-linear map from any complex source, the associated-bilinear-form diagonal
of the image of `J₀ v` equals that of the image of `v`.
decls.statement:
lemma associatedBilinForm_apply_apply_self_eq
    (hF : IsComplexLinearMap J₀ J F) (v : U) :
    ω.associatedBilinForm J (F (J₀ v)) (F (J₀ v)) =
      ω.associatedBilinForm J (F v) (F v)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsComplexLinearMap.associatedBilinForm_apply_self_eq_symplecticForm
decls.doc:
For a complex-linear map from any complex source, the associated-bilinear-form diagonal
of an image vector is the symplectic area density of the ordered pair `(F v, F (J₀ v))`.
decls.statement:
lemma associatedBilinForm_apply_self_eq_symplecticForm
    (hF : IsComplexLinearMap J₀ J F) (v : U) :
    ω.associatedBilinForm J (F v) (F v) = ω (F v) (F (J₀ v))

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.associatedBilinForm_apply_right_apply
decls.doc:
Applying `J` to the right argument of the metric `g(v, w) = ω(v, J w)` negates the symplectic
form: `g(v, J w) = -ω(v, w)`. This uses only `J² = -1`, not compatibility.
decls.statement:
lemma associatedBilinForm_apply_right_apply (v w : V) :
    ω.associatedBilinForm J v (J w) = -ω v w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Invariant.apply
decls.doc: Pointwise form of invariance under applying `J` to both arguments.
decls.statement: lemma apply (hinv : ω.Invariant J) (v w : V) : ω (J v) (J w) = ω v w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Invariant.associatedBilinForm_apply_left_apply
decls.doc: The metric recovers the symplectic form: `g(J v, w) = ω(v, w)`.
decls.statement:
lemma associatedBilinForm_apply_left_apply (hinv : ω.Invariant J) (v w : V) :
    ω.associatedBilinForm J (J v) w = ω v w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Invariant.symplecticForm_apply_eq_associatedBilinForm_apply_left_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise recovery of the symplectic form from the metric and `J`: `ω(v, w) = g(J v, w)`.
decls.statement:
lemma symplecticForm_apply_eq_associatedBilinForm_apply_left_apply
    (hinv : ω.Invariant J) (v w : V) :
    ω v w = ω.associatedBilinForm J (J v) w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Invariant.associatedBilinForm_invariant
decls.doc: `J` is an isometry of the metric `g`: `g(J v, J w) = g(v, w)`.
decls.statement:
lemma associatedBilinForm_invariant (hinv : ω.Invariant J) (v w : V) :
    ω.associatedBilinForm J (J v) (J w) = ω.associatedBilinForm J v w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Invariant.associatedBilinForm_skewAdjoint
decls.doc: `J` is skew-adjoint for the metric `g`: `g(J v, w) = -g(v, J w)`.
decls.statement:
lemma associatedBilinForm_skewAdjoint (hinv : ω.Invariant J) (v w : V) :
    ω.associatedBilinForm J (J v) w = -ω.associatedBilinForm J v (J w)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Invariant.associatedBilinForm_add_apply_self
decls.doc:
The polarization identity for the associated metric of a `J`-invariant form:
`g(a + J b, a + J b) = g(a, a) + g(b, b) - 2 ω(a, b)`, where
`g = ω.associatedBilinForm J`.
decls.statement:
lemma associatedBilinForm_add_apply_self (hinv : ω.Invariant J) (a b : V) :
    ω.associatedBilinForm J (a + J b) (a + J b) =
      ω.associatedBilinForm J a a + ω.associatedBilinForm J b b - 2 * ω a b

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.associatedBilinForm_self_nonneg
decls.doc: The metric `g(v, v) = ω(v, J v)` is nonnegative under positive-definiteness.
decls.statement:
lemma associatedBilinForm_self_nonneg
    (hpositive : (ω.associatedBilinForm J).toQuadraticMap.PosDef) (v : V) :
    0 ≤ ω.associatedBilinForm J v v

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.symplecticForm_apply_apply_self_nonneg
decls.doc: The diagonal `ω(v, J v)` is nonnegative under positive-definiteness of the associated metric.
decls.statement:
lemma symplecticForm_apply_apply_self_nonneg
    (hpositive : (ω.associatedBilinForm J).toQuadraticMap.PosDef) (v : V) : 0 ≤ ω v (J v)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.associatedBilinForm_self_eq_zero
decls.doc: Positive-definiteness of the associated metric detects zero vectors on the diagonal.
decls.statement:
lemma associatedBilinForm_self_eq_zero
    (hpositive : (ω.associatedBilinForm J).toQuadraticMap.PosDef) {v : V} :
    ω.associatedBilinForm J v v = 0 ↔ v = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible.associatedBilinForm_apply_left_apply
decls.doc: The metric recovers the symplectic form: `g(J v, w) = ω(v, w)`.
decls.statement:
lemma associatedBilinForm_apply_left_apply (h : ω.Compatible J) (v w : V) :
    ω.associatedBilinForm J (J v) w = ω v w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible.symplecticForm_apply_eq_associatedBilinForm_apply_left_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise recovery of the symplectic form from the metric and `J`: `ω(v, w) = g(J v, w)`.
decls.statement:
lemma symplecticForm_apply_eq_associatedBilinForm_apply_left_apply
    (h : ω.Compatible J) (v w : V) :
    ω v w = ω.associatedBilinForm J (J v) w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible.associatedBilinForm_invariant
decls.doc: `J` is an isometry of the metric `g`: `g(J v, J w) = g(v, w)`.
decls.statement:
lemma associatedBilinForm_invariant (h : ω.Compatible J) (v w : V) :
    ω.associatedBilinForm J (J v) (J w) = ω.associatedBilinForm J v w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible.associatedBilinForm_skewAdjoint
decls.doc: `J` is skew-adjoint for the metric `g`: `g(J v, w) = -g(v, J w)`.
decls.statement:
lemma associatedBilinForm_skewAdjoint (h : ω.Compatible J) (v w : V) :

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible.associatedBilinForm_self_eq_zero

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.complexFinrank
decls.doc:
The complex dimension of `V` with respect to an almost complex structure `J`: the
`ℂ`-dimension of `V` under the complex module structure induced by `J`
(`AlmostComplexStructure.complexModule`).
decls.statement: def complexFinrank (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) : ℕ

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.complexFinrank_def
decls.doc: The complex dimension of `J` is the `ℂ`-dimension of `V` under the induced complex structure.
decls.statement:
lemma complexFinrank_def (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) :
    letI

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.finrank_real_eq_two_mul_complexFinrank
decls.doc:
The real dimension of a module carrying an almost complex structure `J` is twice its complex
dimension: `finrank ℝ V = 2 * J.complexFinrank`. This is the tower law `finrank ℝ V =
finrank ℝ ℂ * finrank ℂ V` together with `finrank ℝ ℂ = 2`.
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_real_eq_two_mul_complexFinrank (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) :
    Module.finrank ℝ V = 2 * J.complexFinrank

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.even_finrank_real
decls.doc: The real dimension of a module carrying an almost complex structure is even.
decls.statement:
theorem even_finrank_real (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) :
    Even (Module.finrank ℝ V)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.finrank_eq_complexFinrank_of_isMaximalTotallyReal
decls.doc:
A maximal totally real subspace `L` of a finite-dimensional almost complex module has real
dimension equal to the complex dimension of the ambient module: `L` is "half-dimensional".

For a Heegaard diagram of genus `g`, this is the statement that the totally real tori `T_α`,
`T_β` are `g`-dimensional inside the `g`-complex-dimensional symmetric product `Sym^g(Σ)`
(Ozsváth--Szabó, [arXiv:math/0101206](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0101206), Section 2).
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_eq_complexFinrank_of_isMaximalTotallyReal [FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
    {J : AlmostComplexStructure V} {L : Submodule ℝ V}
    (hL : IsMaximalTotallyReal J.toLinearMap L) :
    Module.finrank ℝ L = J.complexFinrank

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.isEmpty_of_odd_finrank
decls.doc: An odd-dimensional real module admits no almost complex structure.
decls.statement:
theorem isEmpty_of_odd_finrank (h : Odd (Module.finrank ℝ V)) :
    IsEmpty (AlmostComplexStructure V)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.complexAssociatedForm
decls.doc:
The complex form associated to a pair `(ω, J)`: `h(v, w) = ω(v, J w) + i ω(v, w)`.

Its real part is the metric `ω(·, J ·)` and its imaginary part is the symplectic form `ω`. The
bare definition needs no hypotheses on `(ω, J)`; the Hermitian-structure facts are each proved
under the weakest hypothesis they need: complex linearity in the second argument from `J² = -1`
alone (`complexAssociatedForm_smul_right`), conjugate symmetry and conjugate-linearity in the first
argument from `ω.Invariant J` (`Invariant.complexAssociatedForm_conj_symm`,
`Invariant.complexAssociatedForm_smul_left`), and positive definiteness from `ω.Tames J`
(`Tames.complexAssociatedForm_self_re_pos`). Full compatibility is needed only to assemble
`Compatible.hermitianCore`.
decls.statement:
def complexAssociatedForm (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V)
    (v w : V) : ℂ

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.complexAssociatedForm_apply
decls.statement:
lemma complexAssociatedForm_apply (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V)
    (v w : V) :
    ω.complexAssociatedForm J v w = (ω v (J w) : ℂ) + Complex.I * (ω v w : ℂ)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.complexAssociatedForm_re
decls.doc: The real part of the complex associated form is the metric `g(v, w) = ω(v, J w)`.
decls.statement:
lemma complexAssociatedForm_re (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V)
    (v w : V) :
    (ω.complexAssociatedForm J v w).re = ω v (J w)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.complexAssociatedForm_im
decls.doc: The imaginary part of the complex associated form is the symplectic form `ω(v, w)`.
decls.statement:
lemma complexAssociatedForm_im (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V)
    (v w : V) :
    (ω.complexAssociatedForm J v w).im = ω v w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.complexAssociatedForm_add_left
decls.doc: The complex associated form is additive in its first argument.
decls.statement:
lemma complexAssociatedForm_add_left (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V)
    (v₁ v₂ w : V) :
    ω.complexAssociatedForm J (v₁ + v₂) w =
      ω.complexAssociatedForm J v₁ w + ω.complexAssociatedForm J v₂ w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.complexAssociatedForm_add_right
decls.doc: The complex associated form is additive in its second argument.
decls.statement:
lemma complexAssociatedForm_add_right (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V)
    (v w₁ w₂ : V) :
    ω.complexAssociatedForm J v (w₁ + w₂) =
      ω.complexAssociatedForm J v w₁ + ω.complexAssociatedForm J v w₂

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.complexAssociatedForm_smul_right_aux
decls.doc:
Auxiliary real-scalar form of complex linearity in the second argument: feeding the real
decomposition `r.re • w + r.im • J w` of `r • w` to the second slot multiplies by `r`. This needs
only `J² = -1`, not compatibility.
decls.statement:
lemma complexAssociatedForm_smul_right_aux
    (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V)
    (r : ℂ) (v w : V) :
    ω.complexAssociatedForm J v (r.re • w + r.im • J w) =
      r * ω.complexAssociatedForm J v w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.complexAssociatedForm_smul_right
decls.doc:
The complex associated form is complex linear in its second argument over the complex structure
`J.complexModule`: `h(v, z • w) = z · h(v, w)`. This is one of the defining properties of a
Hermitian inner product on the complex vector space `(V, J)`, and needs only `J² = -1`, not
compatibility.
decls.statement:
lemma complexAssociatedForm_smul_right (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V)
    (z : ℂ) (v w : V) :
    letI

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.complexAssociatedForm_self
decls.doc:
The diagonal of the complex associated form is real and equals the metric diagonal
`ω(v, J v)`.
decls.statement:
lemma complexAssociatedForm_self (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) (v : V) :
    ω.complexAssociatedForm J v v = (ω v (J v) : ℂ)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames.complexAssociatedForm_self_re_pos
decls.doc: The diagonal of the Hermitian form is positive on nonzero vectors. Only tameness is needed.
decls.statement:
lemma complexAssociatedForm_self_re_pos (htames : ω.Tames J) {v : V} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    0 < (ω.complexAssociatedForm J v v).re

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames.complexAssociatedForm_self_re_nonneg
decls.doc:
The real part of the diagonal of the Hermitian form is nonnegative, in the `RCLike.re` form
the inner-product-space core expects. Only tameness is needed.
decls.statement:
lemma complexAssociatedForm_self_re_nonneg (htames : ω.Tames J) (v : V) :
    0 ≤ RCLike.re (ω.complexAssociatedForm J v v)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames.complexAssociatedForm_self_eq_zero
decls.doc: The diagonal of the Hermitian form vanishes exactly at zero. Only tameness is needed.
decls.statement:
lemma complexAssociatedForm_self_eq_zero (htames : ω.Tames J) {v : V} :
    ω.complexAssociatedForm J v v = 0 ↔ v = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Invariant.complexAssociatedForm_conj_symm
decls.doc:
The Hermitian form is conjugate-symmetric: `conj (h(w, v)) = h(v, w)`. Only `J`-invariance is
needed.
decls.statement:
lemma complexAssociatedForm_conj_symm (hinv : ω.Invariant J) (v w : V) :
    (starRingEnd ℂ) (ω.complexAssociatedForm J w v) = ω.complexAssociatedForm J v w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Invariant.complexAssociatedForm_smul_left_aux

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity
decls.doc:
The pointwise metric energy density of a real-linear map from the standard complex line.

For a compatible pair `(ω, J)`, this is
`g(F ∂s, F ∂s) + g(F ∂t, F ∂t)`, where `g(v,w) = ω(v, J w)`.
decls.statement:
irreducible_def stdComplexLineEnergyDensity (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V)
    (F : (ℝ × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] V) : ℝ

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_def
decls.statement:
irreducible_def stdComplexLineEnergyDensity (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V)
    (F : (ℝ × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] V) : ℝ

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_nonneg
decls.doc: The standard pointwise energy density of any real-linear map is nonnegative under tameness.
decls.statement:
lemma stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_nonneg (hω : ω.Tames J)
    (F : (ℝ × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] V) :
    0 ≤ ω.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J F

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_pos
decls.doc:
Under tameness, the standard pointwise energy density of a nonzero real-linear map from the
standard complex line is positive.

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_eq_zero_iff
decls.doc:
Under tameness, standard pointwise energy density vanishes exactly for the zero real-linear
map from the standard complex line.
decls.statement:
lemma stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_eq_zero_iff (hω : ω.Tames J)
    {F : (ℝ × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] V} :
    ω.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J F = 0 ↔ F = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_pos_iff
decls.doc:
Under tameness, the standard pointwise energy density is positive exactly for nonzero
real-linear maps from the standard complex line.
decls.statement:
lemma stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_pos_iff (hω : ω.Tames J) {F : (ℝ × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] V} :
    0 < ω.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J F ↔ F ≠ 0

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_toLinearMap_eq_zero_iff
decls.doc:
Under tameness, standard pointwise energy density of a continuous linear map vanishes exactly
when the continuous linear map is zero.
decls.statement:
lemma stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_toLinearMap_eq_zero_iff
    [TopologicalSpace V] (hω : ω.Tames J) (F : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] V) :
    ω.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J F.toLinearMap = 0 ↔ F = 0

decls.doc:
Under tameness, the standard pointwise energy density of a continuous linear map is positive
exactly when the continuous linear map is nonzero.
decls.statement:
lemma stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_toLinearMap_pos_iff
    [TopologicalSpace V] (hω : ω.Tames J) (F : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] V) :
    0 < ω.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J F.toLinearMap ↔ F ≠ 0

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.prod_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity
decls.doc:
The standard-line energy density of a real-linear map into a direct-sum target is the sum of
the two factor energy densities of its coordinate projections.
decls.statement:
lemma prod_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity (F : (ℝ × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] V × W) :
    (ω₁.prod ω₂).stdComplexLineEnergyDensity (J₁.prod J₂) F =
      ω₁.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J₁ ((LinearMap.fst ℝ V W).comp F) +
        ω₂.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J₂ ((LinearMap.snd ℝ V W).comp F)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsComplexLinearMap.associatedBilinForm_apply_stdComplexLineImag_self_eq
decls.doc:
For a complex-linear map out of the standard complex line, the associated-bilinear-form
diagonal of the imaginary-coordinate image equals that of the real-coordinate image.
decls.statement:
lemma associatedBilinForm_apply_stdComplexLineImag_self_eq
    (hF : IsComplexLinearMap (AlmostComplexStructure.product ℝ) J F) :
    ω.associatedBilinForm J (F stdComplexLineImag) (F stdComplexLineImag) =
      ω.associatedBilinForm J (F stdComplexLineReal) (F stdComplexLineReal)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsComplexLinearMap.associatedBilinForm_apply_stdComplexLineReal_self_eq_symplecticForm
decls.doc:
For a complex-linear map out of the standard complex line, the real-coordinate
associated-bilinear-form diagonal is the symplectic area density of the ordered coordinate
pair.
decls.statement:
lemma associatedBilinForm_apply_stdComplexLineReal_self_eq_symplecticForm
    (hF : IsComplexLinearMap (AlmostComplexStructure.product ℝ) J F) :
    ω.associatedBilinForm J (F stdComplexLineReal) (F stdComplexLineReal) =
      ω (F stdComplexLineReal) (F stdComplexLineImag)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsComplexLinearMap.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_eq_two_mul_symplecticForm
decls.doc:
For a complex-linear map out of the standard complex line, the standard pointwise energy
density is twice the symplectic area density.
decls.statement:
lemma stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_eq_two_mul_symplecticForm
    (hF : IsComplexLinearMap (AlmostComplexStructure.product ℝ) J F) :
    ω.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J F =
      2 * ω (F stdComplexLineReal) (F stdComplexLineImag)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsConstStructureJHolomorphicAt.associatedBilinForm_fderiv_stdComplexLineImag_self_eq
decls.doc:
For a pointwise constant-structure `J`-holomorphic map from the standard complex line, the
associated-bilinear-form diagonal of the `∂t` derivative equals that of the `∂s` derivative.
decls.statement:

    (hf : IsConstStructureJHolomorphicAt (AlmostComplexStructure.product ℝ) J f x) :
    ω.associatedBilinForm J (fderiv ℝ f x stdComplexLineImag)
        (fderiv ℝ f x stdComplexLineImag) =
      ω.associatedBilinForm J (fderiv ℝ f x stdComplexLineReal)
        (fderiv ℝ f x stdComplexLineReal)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsConstStructureJHolomorphicAt.associatedBilinForm_fderiv_stdComplexLineReal_self_eq_symplecticForm
decls.doc:
For a pointwise constant-structure `J`-holomorphic map from the standard complex line, the `∂s`
associated-bilinear-form diagonal is the symplectic area density `ω(∂s u, ∂t u)`.
decls.statement:
lemma associatedBilinForm_fderiv_stdComplexLineReal_self_eq_symplecticForm
    (hf : IsConstStructureJHolomorphicAt (AlmostComplexStructure.product ℝ) J f x) :
    ω.associatedBilinForm J (fderiv ℝ f x stdComplexLineReal)
        (fderiv ℝ f x stdComplexLineReal) =
      ω (fderiv ℝ f x stdComplexLineReal) (fderiv ℝ f x stdComplexLineImag)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsConstStructureJHolomorphicAt.fderiv_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_eq_two_mul_symplecticForm
decls.doc:
For a pointwise constant-structure `J`-holomorphic map from the standard complex line, the

standard energy density is twice its symplectic area density.
decls.statement:
lemma fderiv_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_eq_two_mul_symplecticForm
    (hf : IsConstStructureJHolomorphicAt (AlmostComplexStructure.product ℝ) J f x) :
    ω.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J (fderiv ℝ f x).toLinearMap =
      2 * ω (fderiv ℝ f x stdComplexLineReal) (fderiv ℝ f x stdComplexLineImag)

decls.statement:
lemma fderiv_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_nonneg (hω : ω.Tames J) :
    0 ≤ ω.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J (fderiv ℝ f x).toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.IsConstStructureJHolomorphicAt.fderiv_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_eq_zero_iff
