    0 < ω.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J (fderiv ℝ f x).toLinearMap ↔ fderiv ℝ f x ≠ 0

decls.name: TauCeti.IsConstStructureJHolomorphicAt.fderiv_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_pos
decls.doc:
Under tameness, a map with nonzero Frechet derivative has positive standard derivative energy
density.
decls.statement:
lemma fderiv_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_pos (hω : ω.Tames J)
    (hfderiv : fderiv ℝ f x ≠ 0) :
    0 < ω.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J (fderiv ℝ f x).toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.IsConstStructureJHolomorphicWithinAt.associatedBilinForm_fderivWithin_stdComplexLineImag_self_eq
decls.doc:
For a within-set constant-structure `J`-holomorphic map from the standard complex line, the
associated-bilinear-form diagonal of the `∂t` derivative equals that of the `∂s` derivative,
provided derivatives within the set are unique.
decls.statement:
lemma associatedBilinForm_fderivWithin_stdComplexLineImag_self_eq
    (hf : IsConstStructureJHolomorphicWithinAt (AlmostComplexStructure.product ℝ) J f s x)
    (hs : UniqueDiffWithinAt ℝ s x) :
    ω.associatedBilinForm J (fderivWithin ℝ f s x stdComplexLineImag)
        (fderivWithin ℝ f s x stdComplexLineImag) =
      ω.associatedBilinForm J (fderivWithin ℝ f s x stdComplexLineReal)
        (fderivWithin ℝ f s x stdComplexLineReal)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsConstStructureJHolomorphicWithinAt.associatedBilinForm_fderivWithin_stdComplexLineReal_self_eq_symplecticForm
decls.doc:
For a within-set constant-structure `J`-holomorphic map from the standard complex line, the `∂s`
associated-bilinear-form diagonal is the symplectic area density `ω(∂s u, ∂t u)`,
provided derivatives within the set are unique.
decls.statement:
lemma associatedBilinForm_fderivWithin_stdComplexLineReal_self_eq_symplecticForm
    (hf : IsConstStructureJHolomorphicWithinAt (AlmostComplexStructure.product ℝ) J f s x)
    (hs : UniqueDiffWithinAt ℝ s x) :
    ω.associatedBilinForm J (fderivWithin ℝ f s x stdComplexLineReal)
        (fderivWithin ℝ f s x stdComplexLineReal) =
      ω (fderivWithin ℝ f s x stdComplexLineReal)
        (fderivWithin ℝ f s x stdComplexLineImag)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsConstStructureJHolomorphicWithinAt.fderivWithin_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_eq_two_mul_symplecticForm
decls.doc:
For a within-set constant-structure `J`-holomorphic map from the standard complex line, the
derivative's
standard energy density is twice its symplectic area density, provided derivatives within the
set are unique.
decls.statement:
lemma fderivWithin_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_eq_two_mul_symplecticForm
    (hf : IsConstStructureJHolomorphicWithinAt (AlmostComplexStructure.product ℝ) J f s x)
    (hs : UniqueDiffWithinAt ℝ s x) :
    ω.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J (fderivWithin ℝ f s x).toLinearMap =
      2 * ω (fderivWithin ℝ f s x stdComplexLineReal)
        (fderivWithin ℝ f s x stdComplexLineImag)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsConstStructureJHolomorphicWithinAt.fderivWithin_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_nonneg
decls.doc: The within-set derivative's standard pointwise energy density is nonnegative under tameness.
decls.statement:
lemma fderivWithin_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_nonneg (hω : ω.Tames J) :
    0 ≤ ω.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J (fderivWithin ℝ f s x).toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.IsConstStructureJHolomorphicWithinAt.fderivWithin_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_eq_zero_iff
decls.doc:
Under tameness, the within-set derivative standard energy density of a map from the standard
complex line vanishes exactly when its Frechet derivative within the set is zero.
decls.statement:
lemma fderivWithin_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_eq_zero_iff (hω : ω.Tames J) :
    ω.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J (fderivWithin ℝ f s x).toLinearMap = 0 ↔
      fderivWithin ℝ f s x = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.IsConstStructureJHolomorphicWithinAt.fderivWithin_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_pos_iff
decls.doc:
Under tameness, the within-set derivative standard energy density is positive exactly when
the Frechet derivative within the set is nonzero.
decls.statement:
lemma fderivWithin_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_pos_iff (hω : ω.Tames J) :
    0 < ω.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J (fderivWithin ℝ f s x).toLinearMap ↔
      fderivWithin ℝ f s x ≠ 0

decls.name: TauCeti.IsConstStructureJHolomorphicWithinAt.fderivWithin_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_pos
decls.doc:
Under tameness, a map with nonzero Frechet derivative within a set has positive standard
derivative energy density.
decls.statement:
lemma fderivWithin_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_pos (hω : ω.Tames J)
    (hfderiv : fderivWithin ℝ f s x ≠ 0) :
    0 < ω.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J (fderivWithin ℝ f s x).toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_sub_two_mul_symplecticForm
decls.doc:
The Wirtinger identity out of the standard complex line: the standard energy density minus
twice the symplectic area density is the Cauchy--Riemann defect square
`g(F ∂s + J (F ∂t), F ∂s + J (F ∂t))`. Needs only `J`-invariance of `ω`.
decls.statement:
lemma stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_sub_two_mul_symplecticForm (hinv : ω.Invariant J)
    (F : (ℝ × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] V) :
    ω.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J F -
        2 * ω (F stdComplexLineReal) (F stdComplexLineImag) =
      ω.associatedBilinForm J (F stdComplexLineReal + J (F stdComplexLineImag))
        (F stdComplexLineReal + J (F stdComplexLineImag))

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.two_mul_symplecticForm_le_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity
decls.doc:
**Wirtinger inequality.** For a compatible pair `(ω, J)` and any real-linear map out of the
standard complex line, twice the symplectic area density of the ordered coordinate pair is at
most the standard energy density: the local form of `E(u) ≥ ∫ u^*ω`.
decls.title: Wirtinger inequality
decls.statement:
lemma two_mul_symplecticForm_le_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity (hcompat : ω.Compatible J)
    (F : (ℝ × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] V) :
    2 * ω (F stdComplexLineReal) (F stdComplexLineImag) ≤
      ω.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J F

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_eq_two_mul_symplecticForm_iff
decls.doc:
The Wirtinger inequality is an equality exactly when the map is complex linear, that is,
constant-structure `J`-holomorphic out of the standard complex line: the energy density then equals
twice the
symplectic area density.
decls.statement:
lemma stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_eq_two_mul_symplecticForm_iff (hcompat : ω.Compatible J)
    (F : (ℝ × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] V) :
    ω.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J F =
        2 * ω (F stdComplexLineReal) (F stdComplexLineImag) ↔
      IsComplexLinearMap (AlmostComplexStructure.product ℝ) J F

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.two_mul_symplecticForm_fderiv_le_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity
decls.doc:
The Wirtinger inequality for the Frechet derivative of any map from the standard complex
line: twice the symplectic area density of the derivative's coordinate pair is at most its
standard energy density.
decls.statement:
lemma two_mul_symplecticForm_fderiv_le_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity (hcompat : ω.Compatible J)
    (x : ℝ × ℝ) :
    2 * ω (fderiv ℝ f x stdComplexLineReal) (fderiv ℝ f x stdComplexLineImag) ≤
      ω.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J (fderiv ℝ f x).toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.two_mul_symplecticForm_fderivWithin_le_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity
decls.doc:
The Wirtinger inequality for the within-set Frechet derivative of any map from the standard
complex line.
decls.statement:
lemma two_mul_symplecticForm_fderivWithin_le_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity
    (hcompat : ω.Compatible J) (s : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (x : ℝ × ℝ) :
    2 * ω (fderivWithin ℝ f s x stdComplexLineReal)
        (fderivWithin ℝ f s x stdComplexLineImag) ≤
      ω.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity J (fderivWithin ℝ f s x).toLinearMap

For a constant-structure `J`-holomorphic map from the standard complex line, the Frechet

decls.doc:
A map into a direct-sum target is constant-structure `J`-holomorphic on a set iff both
coordinate maps are.

decls.name: TauCeti.isJHolomorphicAt_iff
decls.doc: Restate pointwise J-holomorphicity as the existence of a complex-linear derivative.
decls.statement:
lemma isJHolomorphicAt_iff (J : U → AlmostComplexStructure U)
    (J' : V → AlmostComplexStructure V) (f : U → V) (x : U) :
    IsJHolomorphicAt J J' f x ↔
      ∃ f' : U →L[ℝ] V,
        HasFDerivAt f f' x ∧ IsComplexLinearMap (J x) (J' (f x)) f'.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.isJHolomorphicWithinAt_iff
decls.doc:
Restate within-set J-holomorphicity as the existence of a complex-linear derivative
within the set.
decls.statement:
lemma isJHolomorphicWithinAt_iff (J : U → AlmostComplexStructure U)
    (J' : V → AlmostComplexStructure V) (f : U → V) (s : Set U) (x : U) :
    IsJHolomorphicWithinAt J J' f s x ↔
      ∃ f' : U →L[ℝ] V,
        HasFDerivWithinAt f f' s x ∧ IsComplexLinearMap (J x) (J' (f x)) f'.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.isJHolomorphicOn_iff
decls.doc: Restate setwise J-holomorphicity as the pointwise within-set condition.
decls.statement:
lemma isJHolomorphicOn_iff (J : U → AlmostComplexStructure U)
    (J' : V → AlmostComplexStructure V) (f : U → V) (s : Set U) :
    IsJHolomorphicOn J J' f s ↔
      ∀ x ∈ s, IsJHolomorphicWithinAt J J' f s x

decls.name: TauCeti.isJHolomorphic_iff
decls.doc: Restate global J-holomorphicity as pointwise J-holomorphicity everywhere.
decls.statement:
lemma isJHolomorphic_iff (J : U → AlmostComplexStructure U)
    (J' : V → AlmostComplexStructure V) (f : U → V) :
    IsJHolomorphic J J' f ↔ ∀ x, IsJHolomorphicAt J J' f x

lemma IsJHolomorphicWithinAt.fderivWithin_isComplexLinear
    {J : U → AlmostComplexStructure U} {J' : V → AlmostComplexStructure V}
    {f : U → V} {s : Set U} {x : U} (hf : IsJHolomorphicWithinAt J J' f s x)

lemma IsJHolomorphicWithinAt.fderivWithin_apply_commute

lemma isJHolomorphicWithinAt_id (J : U → AlmostComplexStructure U) (s : Set U) (x : U) :
    IsJHolomorphicWithinAt J J id s x

decls.name: TauCeti.isJHolomorphicWithinAt_const
decls.doc: A constant map is J-holomorphic within every set at every point.
decls.statement:
lemma isJHolomorphicWithinAt_const (J : U → AlmostComplexStructure U)
    (J' : V → AlmostComplexStructure V) (c : V) (s : Set U) (x : U) :
    IsJHolomorphicWithinAt J J' (fun _ ↦ c) s x

decls.name: TauCeti.isJHolomorphicOn_id
decls.doc: The identity map is J-holomorphic on every set.
decls.statement:
lemma isJHolomorphicOn_id (J : U → AlmostComplexStructure U) (s : Set U) :
    IsJHolomorphicOn J J id s

decls.name: TauCeti.isJHolomorphicOn_const
decls.doc: A constant map is J-holomorphic on every set.
decls.statement:
lemma isJHolomorphicOn_const (J : U → AlmostComplexStructure U)
    (J' : V → AlmostComplexStructure V) (c : V) (s : Set U) :
    IsJHolomorphicOn J J' (fun _ ↦ c) s

decls.name: TauCeti.isJHolomorphic_id
decls.doc: The identity map is J-holomorphic for every varying almost complex structure.
decls.statement:
lemma isJHolomorphic_id (J : U → AlmostComplexStructure U) :
    IsJHolomorphic J J id

decls.name: TauCeti.isJHolomorphic_const
decls.doc: A constant map is J-holomorphic for arbitrary source and target structures.
decls.statement:
lemma isJHolomorphic_const (J : U → AlmostComplexStructure U)
    (J' : V → AlmostComplexStructure V) (c : V) :
    IsJHolomorphic J J' (fun _ ↦ c)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsJHolomorphicAt.comp
decls.doc: The composition of two J-holomorphic maps is J-holomorphic at a point.

decls.name: TauCeti.IsJHolomorphicWithinAt.comp
decls.doc: The composition of two within-set J-holomorphic maps is J-holomorphic within the source set.

decls.name: TauCeti.IsJHolomorphicOn.comp
decls.doc: The composition of two setwise J-holomorphic maps is J-holomorphic on the source set.

decls.name: TauCeti.IsJHolomorphic.comp
decls.doc: The composition of two globally J-holomorphic maps is globally J-holomorphic.

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.orthogonal
decls.doc:
The symplectic complement `L^ω = {x | ∀ y ∈ L, ω(y, x) = 0}` of a submodule `L`, namely the
orthogonal complement of `L` for the bilinear form `ω`.
decls.statement: def orthogonal (ω : SymplecticForm V) (L : Submodule ℝ V) : Submodule ℝ V

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.orthogonal_def
decls.statement:
lemma orthogonal_def (ω : SymplecticForm V) (L : Submodule ℝ V) :
    ω.orthogonal L = ω.toBilinForm.orthogonal L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.mem_orthogonal_iff
decls.statement: lemma mem_orthogonal_iff {x : V} : x ∈ ω.orthogonal L ↔ ∀ y ∈ L, ω y x = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.mem_orthogonal_iff'
decls.doc: Membership in the symplectic complement, tested on the left argument of `ω`.
decls.statement: lemma mem_orthogonal_iff' {x : V} : x ∈ ω.orthogonal L ↔ ∀ y ∈ L, ω x y = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.orthogonal_le
decls.doc: The symplectic complement is antitone: a larger subspace has a smaller complement.
decls.statement: lemma orthogonal_le (h : L ≤ L') : ω.orthogonal L' ≤ ω.orthogonal L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.le_orthogonal_orthogonal
decls.doc: A subspace is contained in the complement of its complement.
decls.statement: lemma le_orthogonal_orthogonal : L ≤ ω.orthogonal (ω.orthogonal L)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsIsotropic
decls.doc:
A submodule is isotropic if it is contained in its symplectic complement, equivalently `ω`
vanishes on it.
decls.statement: def IsIsotropic (ω : SymplecticForm V) (L : Submodule ℝ V) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsCoisotropic
decls.doc: A submodule is coisotropic if it contains its symplectic complement.
decls.statement: def IsCoisotropic (ω : SymplecticForm V) (L : Submodule ℝ V) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsLagrangian
decls.doc: A submodule is Lagrangian if it equals its own symplectic complement.
decls.statement: def IsLagrangian (ω : SymplecticForm V) (L : Submodule ℝ V) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isIsotropic_iff_le
decls.doc: Isotropy as an order statement: `L` is contained in its symplectic complement.
decls.statement: lemma isIsotropic_iff_le : ω.IsIsotropic L ↔ L ≤ ω.orthogonal L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isCoisotropic_iff_le
decls.doc: Coisotropy as an order statement: the symplectic complement is contained in `L`.
decls.statement: lemma isCoisotropic_iff_le : ω.IsCoisotropic L ↔ ω.orthogonal L ≤ L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isIsotropic_iff
decls.doc: Isotropy is the vanishing of the symplectic form on the subspace.
decls.statement: lemma isIsotropic_iff : ω.IsIsotropic L ↔ ∀ v ∈ L, ∀ w ∈ L, ω v w = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isCoisotropic_iff
decls.doc: Coisotropy is containment of the symplectic complement.
decls.statement: lemma isCoisotropic_iff : ω.IsCoisotropic L ↔ ∀ v, v ∈ ω.orthogonal L → v ∈ L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsIsotropic.mono
decls.doc: A subspace of an isotropic subspace is isotropic.
decls.statement: lemma IsIsotropic.mono (h : ω.IsIsotropic L') (hL : L ≤ L') : ω.IsIsotropic L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isIsotropic_bot
decls.doc: The zero subspace is isotropic.
decls.statement: lemma isIsotropic_bot : ω.IsIsotropic (⊥ : Submodule ℝ V)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isCoisotropic_top
decls.doc: The whole space is coisotropic.
decls.statement: lemma isCoisotropic_top : ω.IsCoisotropic (⊤ : Submodule ℝ V)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isLagrangian_iff
decls.doc: A Lagrangian subspace is both isotropic and coisotropic, and conversely.
decls.statement: lemma isLagrangian_iff : ω.IsLagrangian L ↔ ω.IsIsotropic L ∧ ω.IsCoisotropic L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsLagrangian.isIsotropic
decls.doc: A Lagrangian subspace is isotropic.
decls.statement: lemma IsLagrangian.isIsotropic (h : ω.IsLagrangian L) : ω.IsIsotropic L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsLagrangian.isCoisotropic
decls.doc: A Lagrangian subspace is coisotropic.
decls.statement: lemma IsLagrangian.isCoisotropic (h : ω.IsLagrangian L) : ω.IsCoisotropic L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsLagrangian.symplecticForm_apply_eq_zero
decls.doc: The symplectic form vanishes on a Lagrangian subspace.
decls.statement:
lemma IsLagrangian.symplecticForm_apply_eq_zero (h : ω.IsLagrangian L) {v w : V}
    (hv : v ∈ L) (hw : w ∈ L) : ω v w = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.finrank_orthogonal
decls.doc: The symplectic complement has complementary dimension: `dim L^ω = dim V - dim L`.
decls.statement:
lemma finrank_orthogonal (ω : SymplecticForm V) (L : Submodule ℝ V) :
    finrank ℝ (ω.orthogonal L) = finrank ℝ V - finrank ℝ L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.orthogonal_orthogonal
decls.doc: The double complement of a subspace is itself.
decls.statement:
lemma orthogonal_orthogonal (ω : SymplecticForm V) (L : Submodule ℝ V) :
    ω.orthogonal (ω.orthogonal L) = L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsIsotropic.two_mul_finrank_le
decls.doc: An isotropic subspace has at most half the dimension of the ambient space.
decls.statement:
lemma IsIsotropic.two_mul_finrank_le (h : ω.IsIsotropic L) :
    2 * finrank ℝ L ≤ finrank ℝ V

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsLagrangian.two_mul_finrank
decls.doc: A Lagrangian subspace is exactly half-dimensional: `2 · dim L = dim V`.
decls.statement:
lemma IsLagrangian.two_mul_finrank (h : ω.IsLagrangian L) :
    2 * finrank ℝ L = finrank ℝ V

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsIsotropic.isLagrangian_of_finrank
decls.doc: An isotropic subspace of half the dimension of the ambient space is Lagrangian.
decls.statement:
lemma IsIsotropic.isLagrangian_of_finrank (h : ω.IsIsotropic L)
    (hdim : 2 * finrank ℝ L = finrank ℝ V) : ω.IsLagrangian L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isLagrangian_prod_top_bot
decls.doc: The first coordinate factor `V × {0}` is Lagrangian for the standard symplectic form.
decls.statement:
lemma isLagrangian_prod_top_bot :
    (stdSymplecticForm (V := V)).IsLagrangian ((⊤ : Submodule ℝ V).prod ⊥)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isLagrangian_prod_bot_top
decls.doc: The second coordinate factor `{0} × V` is Lagrangian for the standard symplectic form.
decls.statement:
lemma isLagrangian_prod_bot_top :
    (stdSymplecticForm (V := V)).IsLagrangian ((⊥ : Submodule ℝ V).prod ⊤)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.orthogonal_prod
decls.doc:
The symplectic complement of a product subspace is the product of the symplectic
complements for the direct-sum symplectic form.
decls.statement:
lemma orthogonal_prod :
    (ω₁.prod ω₂).orthogonal (L₁.prod L₂) = (ω₁.orthogonal L₁).prod (ω₂.orthogonal L₂)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isIsotropic_prod_iff
decls.doc:
A product subspace is isotropic for the direct-sum symplectic form exactly when both factors
are isotropic.
decls.statement:
lemma isIsotropic_prod_iff :
    (ω₁.prod ω₂).IsIsotropic (L₁.prod L₂) ↔ ω₁.IsIsotropic L₁ ∧ ω₂.IsIsotropic L₂

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsIsotropic.prod
decls.doc: The product of two isotropic subspaces is isotropic for the direct-sum symplectic form.
decls.statement:
lemma IsIsotropic.prod (h₁ : ω₁.IsIsotropic L₁) (h₂ : ω₂.IsIsotropic L₂) :
    (ω₁.prod ω₂).IsIsotropic (L₁.prod L₂)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isCoisotropic_prod_iff
decls.doc:
A product subspace is coisotropic for the direct-sum symplectic form exactly when both
factors are coisotropic.
decls.statement:
lemma isCoisotropic_prod_iff :
    (ω₁.prod ω₂).IsCoisotropic (L₁.prod L₂) ↔
      ω₁.IsCoisotropic L₁ ∧ ω₂.IsCoisotropic L₂

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsCoisotropic.prod
decls.doc: The product of two coisotropic subspaces is coisotropic for the direct-sum symplectic form.
decls.statement:
lemma IsCoisotropic.prod (h₁ : ω₁.IsCoisotropic L₁) (h₂ : ω₂.IsCoisotropic L₂) :
    (ω₁.prod ω₂).IsCoisotropic (L₁.prod L₂)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isLagrangian_prod_iff
decls.doc:
A product subspace is Lagrangian for the direct-sum symplectic form exactly when both factors
are Lagrangian.
decls.statement:
lemma isLagrangian_prod_iff :
    (ω₁.prod ω₂).IsLagrangian (L₁.prod L₂) ↔
      ω₁.IsLagrangian L₁ ∧ ω₂.IsLagrangian L₂

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsLagrangian.prod
decls.doc: The product of two Lagrangian subspaces is Lagrangian for the direct-sum symplectic form.
decls.statement:
lemma IsLagrangian.prod (h₁ : ω₁.IsLagrangian L₁) (h₂ : ω₂.IsLagrangian L₂) :
    (ω₁.prod ω₂).IsLagrangian (L₁.prod L₂)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.orthogonal_map_transport
decls.doc:
The symplectic complement of a transported subspace is the transport of the symplectic
complement.
decls.statement:
lemma orthogonal_map_transport :
    (ω.transport e).orthogonal (L.map e.toLinearMap) = (ω.orthogonal L).map e.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isIsotropic_map_transport_iff
decls.doc:
Isotropy is invariant under transporting both the symplectic form and the subspace along a
linear equivalence.
decls.statement:
lemma isIsotropic_map_transport_iff :
    (ω.transport e).IsIsotropic (L.map e.toLinearMap) ↔ ω.IsIsotropic L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isCoisotropic_map_transport_iff
decls.doc:
Coisotropy is invariant under transporting both the symplectic form and the subspace along a
linear equivalence.
decls.statement:
lemma isCoisotropic_map_transport_iff :
    (ω.transport e).IsCoisotropic (L.map e.toLinearMap) ↔ ω.IsCoisotropic L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isLagrangian_map_transport_iff
decls.doc:
Lagrangian-ness is invariant under transporting both the symplectic form and the subspace
along a linear equivalence.
decls.statement:
lemma isLagrangian_map_transport_iff :
    (ω.transport e).IsLagrangian (L.map e.toLinearMap) ↔ ω.IsLagrangian L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsIsotropic.map_transport
decls.doc:
Transport an isotropic subspace along a linear equivalence, together with the transported
symplectic form.
decls.statement:
lemma map_transport (h : ω.IsIsotropic L) :
    (ω.transport e).IsIsotropic (L.map e.toLinearMap)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsCoisotropic.map_transport
decls.doc:
Transport a coisotropic subspace along a linear equivalence, together with the transported
symplectic form.
decls.statement:
lemma map_transport (h : ω.IsCoisotropic L) :
    (ω.transport e).IsCoisotropic (L.map e.toLinearMap)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsLagrangian.map_transport
decls.doc:
Transport a Lagrangian subspace along a linear equivalence, together with the transported
symplectic form.
decls.statement:
lemma map_transport (h : ω.IsLagrangian L) :
    (ω.transport e).IsLagrangian (L.map e.toLinearMap)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isIsotropic_graph_iff
decls.doc:
The graph of `f` is isotropic for the twisted product form iff `f` preserves the symplectic
forms pointwise: `ω₂(f v, f w) = ω₁(v, w)`.
decls.statement:
lemma isIsotropic_graph_iff {f : V →ₗ[ℝ] W} :
    (twistedProd ω₁ ω₂).IsIsotropic f.graph ↔ ∀ v w, ω₂ (f v) (f w) = ω₁ v w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isIsotropic_linearEquiv_graph_iff
decls.doc:
The graph of `e` is isotropic for the twisted product form iff `e` is a symplectomorphism.

This is a plain bridging lemma, not a `simp` lemma: the general `isIsotropic_graph_iff` already
puts graph isotropy into its own normal form, so marking this `@[simp]` too would leave two
competing normal forms for `e.toLinearMap.graph`.
decls.statement:
lemma isIsotropic_linearEquiv_graph_iff {e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W} :
    (twistedProd ω₁ ω₂).IsIsotropic e.toLinearMap.graph ↔ IsSymplectomorphism ω₁ ω₂ e

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsSymplectomorphism.isLagrangian_graph
decls.doc:
The graph of a symplectomorphism `e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W` is a Lagrangian subspace of the twisted
product `(V × W, ω₁ ⊖ ω₂)`. No finite-dimensionality is required.
decls.statement:
lemma IsSymplectomorphism.isLagrangian_graph {e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W} (h : IsSymplectomorphism ω₁ ω₂ e) :
    (twistedProd ω₁ ω₂).IsLagrangian e.toLinearMap.graph

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isLagrangian_graph_iff
decls.doc: The graph of `e` is Lagrangian for the twisted product form iff `e` is a symplectomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma isLagrangian_graph_iff {e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W} :
    (twistedProd ω₁ ω₂).IsLagrangian e.toLinearMap.graph ↔ IsSymplectomorphism ω₁ ω₂ e

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isLagrangian_diagonal
decls.doc:
The diagonal of `(V × V, ω ⊖ ω)`, realized as the graph of the identity equivalence, is
Lagrangian. This is the boundary condition modeled by the identity continuation in Lagrangian
Floer homology.
decls.statement:
lemma isLagrangian_diagonal (ω : SymplecticForm V) :
    (twistedProd ω ω).IsLagrangian (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ V).toLinearMap.graph

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsIsotropic.disjoint_map_of_tames
decls.doc:
An isotropic subspace of a taming pair is disjoint from its `J`-image: `L ⊓ JL = ⊥`.

This uses only taming, never invariance or finite-dimensionality.
decls.statement:
theorem IsIsotropic.disjoint_map_of_tames (h : ω.IsIsotropic L) (htame : ω.Tames J) :
    Disjoint L (L.map J.toLinearMap)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsLagrangian.isMaximalTotallyReal_of_tames
decls.doc:
A Lagrangian subspace of a taming pair on a finite-dimensional space is maximal totally real:
`V = L ⊕ JL`.

Note that only taming is required, not the full compatibility of `(ω, J)`.
decls.statement:
theorem IsLagrangian.isMaximalTotallyReal_of_tames (hL : ω.IsLagrangian L) (htame : ω.Tames J) :
    IsMaximalTotallyReal J.toLinearMap L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsLagrangian.isMaximalTotallyReal_of_compatible
decls.doc:
A Lagrangian subspace of a compatible pair on a finite-dimensional space is maximal totally
real.
decls.statement:
theorem IsLagrangian.isMaximalTotallyReal_of_compatible (hL : ω.IsLagrangian L)
    (h : ω.Compatible J) : IsMaximalTotallyReal J.toLinearMap L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsLagrangian.existsUnique_add_of_tames
decls.doc:
The unique decomposition of every vector as an element of a Lagrangian subspace `L` plus an
element of its `J`-image, for a taming pair on a finite-dimensional space.
decls.statement:
theorem IsLagrangian.existsUnique_add_of_tames (hL : ω.IsLagrangian L) (htame : ω.Tames J)
    (x : V) : ∃! y : L × L.map J.toLinearMap, (y.1 : V) + y.2 = x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.prod
decls.doc:
The direct-sum almost complex structure on `V × W`, acting componentwise by
`(v, w) ↦ (J₁ v, J₂ w)`.

This is the componentwise direct sum, distinct from the doubling structure
`AlmostComplexStructure.product` on `V × V`.
decls.statement:
def prod (J₁ : AlmostComplexStructure V) (J₂ : AlmostComplexStructure W) :
    AlmostComplexStructure (V × W)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.prod_toLinearMap
decls.statement:
lemma prod_toLinearMap (J₁ : AlmostComplexStructure V) (J₂ : AlmostComplexStructure W) :
    (J₁.prod J₂).toLinearMap = J₁.toLinearMap.prodMap J₂.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.prod_apply
decls.statement:
lemma prod_apply (J₁ : AlmostComplexStructure V) (J₂ : AlmostComplexStructure W) (p : V × W) :
    J₁.prod J₂ p = (J₁ p.1, J₂ p.2)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.neg_prod_neg
decls.doc: The direct sum of negations is the negation of the direct sum.
decls.statement:
lemma neg_prod_neg (J₁ : AlmostComplexStructure V) (J₂ : AlmostComplexStructure W) :
    (-J₁).prod (-J₂) = -(J₁.prod J₂)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.isComplexLinearMap_inl
decls.doc: The inclusion of the first factor is complex-linear into the direct sum.
decls.statement:
lemma isComplexLinearMap_inl (J₁ : AlmostComplexStructure V) (J₂ : AlmostComplexStructure W) :
    IsComplexLinearMap J₁ (J₁.prod J₂) (LinearMap.inl ℝ V W)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.isComplexLinearMap_inr
decls.doc: The inclusion of the second factor is complex-linear into the direct sum.
decls.statement:
lemma isComplexLinearMap_inr (J₁ : AlmostComplexStructure V) (J₂ : AlmostComplexStructure W) :
    IsComplexLinearMap J₂ (J₁.prod J₂) (LinearMap.inr ℝ V W)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.isComplexLinearMap_fst
decls.doc: The first projection is complex-linear out of the direct sum.
decls.statement:
lemma isComplexLinearMap_fst (J₁ : AlmostComplexStructure V) (J₂ : AlmostComplexStructure W) :
    IsComplexLinearMap (J₁.prod J₂) J₁ (LinearMap.fst ℝ V W)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.isComplexLinearMap_snd
decls.doc: The second projection is complex-linear out of the direct sum.
decls.statement:
lemma isComplexLinearMap_snd (J₁ : AlmostComplexStructure V) (J₂ : AlmostComplexStructure W) :
    IsComplexLinearMap (J₁.prod J₂) J₂ (LinearMap.snd ℝ V W)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.transport_prod
decls.doc:
Transport distributes over the direct sum: conjugating a direct sum by a product of
equivalences is the direct sum of the conjugates.
decls.statement:
lemma transport_prod (J₁ : AlmostComplexStructure V) (J₂ : AlmostComplexStructure W)
    (e₁ : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] V') (e₂ : W ≃ₗ[ℝ] W') :
    (J₁.prod J₂).transport (e₁.prodCongr e₂) = (J₁.transport e₁).prod (J₂.transport e₂)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsComplexLinearMap.prod
decls.doc:
A pair of complex-linear maps with the same source is complex-linear into the direct-sum
almost complex structure.

decls.name: TauCeti.IsComplexLinearMap.prodMap
decls.doc:
A product map of complex-linear maps is complex-linear for the direct-sum almost complex
structures.

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.prodBilin
decls.doc: The underlying bilinear form of the direct-sum symplectic form.
decls.statement:
def prodBilin (ω₁ : SymplecticForm V) (ω₂ : SymplecticForm W) :
    LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ (V × W)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.prodBilin_apply
decls.statement:
lemma prodBilin_apply (ω₁ : SymplecticForm V) (ω₂ : SymplecticForm W) (p q : V × W) :
    prodBilin ω₁ ω₂ p q = ω₁ p.1 q.1 + ω₂ p.2 q.2

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.prodBilin_isAlt
decls.statement:
lemma prodBilin_isAlt (ω₁ : SymplecticForm V) (ω₂ : SymplecticForm W) :
    (prodBilin ω₁ ω₂).IsAlt

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.prodBilin_nondegenerate
decls.statement:
lemma prodBilin_nondegenerate (ω₁ : SymplecticForm V) (ω₂ : SymplecticForm W) :
    (prodBilin ω₁ ω₂).Nondegenerate

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.prod
decls.doc:
The direct-sum symplectic form on `V × W`, given by
`(ω₁ ⊕ ω₂)((v₁, w₁), (v₂, w₂)) = ω₁(v₁, v₂) + ω₂(w₁, w₂)`.
decls.statement: def prod (ω₁ : SymplecticForm V) (ω₂ : SymplecticForm W) : SymplecticForm (V × W)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.prod_apply
decls.statement:
lemma prod_apply (ω₁ : SymplecticForm V) (ω₂ : SymplecticForm W) (p q : V × W) :
    ω₁.prod ω₂ p q = ω₁ p.1 q.1 + ω₂ p.2 q.2

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.twistedProd
decls.doc:
The twisted product symplectic form `ω₁ ⊖ ω₂` on `V × W`, given by
`(ω₁ ⊖ ω₂)((v₁, w₁), (v₂, w₂)) = ω₁(v₁, v₂) - ω₂(w₁, w₂)`.

It is the direct sum `prod` of `ω₁` with the negation `ω₂.rescale (-1)` of `ω₂`; the body is
`@[no_expose]`, so downstream code uses it through `twistedProd_apply` rather than by unfolding.
decls.statement:
def twistedProd (ω₁ : SymplecticForm V) (ω₂ : SymplecticForm W) :
    SymplecticForm (V × W)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.twistedProd_apply
decls.statement:
lemma twistedProd_apply (ω₁ : SymplecticForm V) (ω₂ : SymplecticForm W) (p q : V × W) :
    twistedProd ω₁ ω₂ p q = ω₁ p.1 q.1 - ω₂ p.2 q.2

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.prod_associatedBilinForm_apply
decls.doc:
The bilinear form `(ω₁ ⊕ ω₂)(·, (J₁ ⊕ J₂) ·)` is the direct sum of the factorwise associated
forms.
decls.statement:
lemma prod_associatedBilinForm_apply (ω₁ : SymplecticForm V) (ω₂ : SymplecticForm W)
    (p q : V × W) :
    (ω₁.prod ω₂).associatedBilinForm (J₁.prod J₂) p q =
      ω₁.associatedBilinForm J₁ p.1 q.1 + ω₂.associatedBilinForm J₂ p.2 q.2

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.prod_apply_prod_self
decls.doc: `(ω₁ ⊕ ω₂)(p, (J₁ ⊕ J₂) p) = ω₁(p.1, J₁ p.1) + ω₂(p.2, J₂ p.2)`.
decls.statement:
lemma prod_apply_prod_self (ω₁ : SymplecticForm V) (ω₂ : SymplecticForm W) (p : V × W) :
    ω₁.prod ω₂ p (J₁.prod J₂ p) = ω₁ p.1 (J₁ p.1) + ω₂ p.2 (J₂ p.2)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.prod_invariant
decls.doc: A direct sum of invariant pairs is invariant.
decls.statement:
lemma prod_invariant (h₁ : ω₁.Invariant J₁) (h₂ : ω₂.Invariant J₂) :
    (ω₁.prod ω₂).Invariant (J₁.prod J₂)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.prod_tames
decls.doc: A direct sum of tame pairs is tame.
decls.statement:
lemma prod_tames (h₁ : ω₁.Tames J₁) (h₂ : ω₂.Tames J₂) :
    (ω₁.prod ω₂).Tames (J₁.prod J₂)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.prod_compatible
decls.doc: A direct sum of compatible pairs is compatible.
decls.statement:
lemma prod_compatible (h₁ : ω₁.Compatible J₁) (h₂ : ω₂.Compatible J₂) :
    (ω₁.prod ω₂).Compatible (J₁.prod J₂)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.prod_symmetrizedBilinForm_apply
decls.doc:
The symmetrized bilinear form of a direct sum is the direct sum of the factor symmetrized
bilinear forms.

Not a `simp` lemma: the `simp` lemma `symmetrizedBilinForm_apply` already rewrites the
left-hand side, and the two rewrites reach sums grouped differently, so marking both would
make the `simp` normal form depend on which lemma fires first.
decls.statement:
lemma prod_symmetrizedBilinForm_apply (p q : V × W) :
    (ω₁.prod ω₂).symmetrizedBilinForm (J₁.prod J₂) p q =
      ω₁.symmetrizedBilinForm J₁ p.1 q.1 + ω₂.symmetrizedBilinForm J₂ p.2 q.2

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames.prod_innerProductCore_inner
decls.doc:
The packaged tame inner product of a direct sum is the sum of the two packaged tame inner
products.

Not a `simp` lemma: the `simp` lemma `Tames.innerProductCore_inner` already rewrites the
left-hand side, and the two rewrites reach sums grouped differently, so marking both would
make the `simp` normal form depend on which lemma fires first. Use this as a named reduction
to the factor metrics.

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames.prod_innerProductCore_inner_inl
decls.doc: The first coordinate inclusion is isometric for the packaged tame product metric.

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames.prod_innerProductCore_inner_inr
decls.doc: The second coordinate inclusion is isometric for the packaged tame product metric.

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames.prod_innerProductCore_inner_inl_inr
decls.doc: The two coordinate summands are orthogonal for the packaged tame product metric.
decls.statement:
lemma prod_innerProductCore_inner_inl_inr (v : V) (w : W) :
    @inner ℝ (V × W) (prod_tames h₁ h₂).innerProductCore.toInner (v, 0) (0, w) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames.prod_innerProductCore_inner_inr_inl
decls.doc: The reverse coordinate orthogonality for the packaged tame product metric.
decls.statement:
lemma prod_innerProductCore_inner_inr_inl (w : W) (v : V) :
    @inner ℝ (V × W) (prod_tames h₁ h₂).innerProductCore.toInner (0, w) (v, 0) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible.prod_innerProductCore_inner
decls.doc:
The packaged compatible inner product of a direct sum is the sum of the two factor packaged
compatible inner products.

Not a `simp` lemma: the `simp` lemma `Compatible.innerProductCore_inner` already rewrites the
left-hand side, so this lemma would never fire from the default `simp` set. Use it as a named
reduction to the factor metrics.

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible.prod_innerProductCore_inner_inl
decls.doc: The first coordinate inclusion is isometric for the packaged compatible product metric.

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible.prod_innerProductCore_inner_inr
decls.doc: The second coordinate inclusion is isometric for the packaged compatible product metric.

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible.prod_innerProductCore_inner_inl_inr
decls.doc: The two coordinate summands are orthogonal for the packaged compatible product metric.
decls.statement:
lemma prod_innerProductCore_inner_inl_inr (v : V) (w : W) :
    @inner ℝ (V × W) (prod_compatible h₁ h₂).innerProductCore.toInner (v, 0) (0, w) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible.prod_innerProductCore_inner_inr_inl
decls.doc: The reverse coordinate orthogonality for the packaged compatible product metric.
decls.statement:
lemma prod_innerProductCore_inner_inr_inl (w : W) (v : V) :
    @inner ℝ (V × W) (prod_compatible h₁ h₂).innerProductCore.toInner (0, w) (v, 0) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.bilinearForm_orthogonal_smul
decls.statement:
lemma bilinearForm_orthogonal_smul {R : Type*} {M : Type*}
    [CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    (B : _root_.LinearMap.BilinForm R M) {L : Submodule R M} {c : R} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (c • B).orthogonal L = B.orthogonal L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.rescale
decls.doc:
The nonzero scalar multiple `c • ω` of a symplectic form.

The hypothesis `c ≠ 0` is needed for nondegeneracy. The construction is not an instance because
there is no closed scalar action at `c = 0`.
decls.statement: def rescale (ω : SymplecticForm V) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) : SymplecticForm V

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.rescale_toBilinForm
decls.statement:
lemma rescale_toBilinForm (ω : SymplecticForm V) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (ω.rescale c hc).toBilinForm = c • ω.toBilinForm

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.rescale_apply
decls.doc: Evaluation of a rescaled symplectic form.
decls.statement:
lemma rescale_apply (ω : SymplecticForm V) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (v w : V) :
    ω.rescale c hc v w = c * ω v w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.rescale_one
decls.statement: lemma rescale_one (ω : SymplecticForm V) (h : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0) : ω.rescale 1 h = ω

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.rescale_rescale
decls.doc: Successive nonzero rescalings multiply the scale factors.
decls.statement:
lemma rescale_rescale (ω : SymplecticForm V) (c d : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    (ω.rescale c hc).rescale d hd = ω.rescale (d * c) (mul_ne_zero hd hc)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.orthogonal_rescale
decls.doc: Nonzero rescaling leaves the symplectic complement of a subspace unchanged.
decls.statement:
lemma orthogonal_rescale (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (ω.rescale c hc).orthogonal L = ω.orthogonal L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isIsotropic_rescale_iff
decls.doc: Nonzero rescaling preserves and reflects isotropic subspaces.
decls.statement:
lemma isIsotropic_rescale_iff (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (ω.rescale c hc).IsIsotropic L ↔ ω.IsIsotropic L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsIsotropic.rescale
decls.doc: Isotropy is preserved by nonzero rescaling of the symplectic form.
decls.statement:
lemma IsIsotropic.rescale (h : ω.IsIsotropic L) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (ω.rescale c hc).IsIsotropic L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isCoisotropic_rescale_iff
decls.doc: Nonzero rescaling preserves and reflects coisotropic subspaces.
decls.statement:
lemma isCoisotropic_rescale_iff (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (ω.rescale c hc).IsCoisotropic L ↔ ω.IsCoisotropic L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsCoisotropic.rescale
decls.doc: Coisotropy is preserved by nonzero rescaling of the symplectic form.
decls.statement:
lemma IsCoisotropic.rescale (h : ω.IsCoisotropic L) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (ω.rescale c hc).IsCoisotropic L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isLagrangian_rescale_iff
decls.doc: Nonzero rescaling preserves and reflects Lagrangian subspaces.
decls.statement:
lemma isLagrangian_rescale_iff (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (ω.rescale c hc).IsLagrangian L ↔ ω.IsLagrangian L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsLagrangian.rescale
decls.doc: Lagrangian subspaces are preserved by nonzero rescaling of the symplectic form.
decls.statement:
lemma IsLagrangian.rescale (h : ω.IsLagrangian L) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (ω.rescale c hc).IsLagrangian L

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.rescale_associatedBilinForm_apply
decls.doc: The associated bilinear form of a rescaled symplectic form is rescaled by the same factor.
decls.statement:
lemma rescale_associatedBilinForm_apply (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (v w : V) :
    (ω.rescale c hc).associatedBilinForm J v w = c * ω.associatedBilinForm J v w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.invariant_rescale_iff
decls.doc: Rescaling by a nonzero scalar preserves and reflects `J`-invariance.
decls.statement:
lemma invariant_rescale_iff (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (ω.rescale c hc).Invariant J ↔ ω.Invariant J

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Invariant.rescale
decls.doc: `J`-invariance is preserved by any nonzero rescaling of the symplectic form.
decls.statement:
lemma Invariant.rescale (h : ω.Invariant J) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (ω.rescale c hc).Invariant J

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.invariant_rescale_neg_iff
decls.doc:
Rescaling by a nonzero scalar and replacing `J` by `-J` preserves and reflects
`J`-invariance.
decls.statement:
lemma invariant_rescale_neg_iff (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (ω.rescale c hc).Invariant (-J) ↔ ω.Invariant J

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.tames_rescale_iff_of_pos
decls.doc: Positive rescaling preserves and reflects tameness.
decls.statement:
lemma tames_rescale_iff_of_pos {c : ℝ} (hcpos : 0 < c) :
    (ω.rescale c hcpos.ne').Tames J ↔ ω.Tames J

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames.rescale_of_pos
decls.doc: Tameness is preserved by positive rescaling of the symplectic form.
decls.statement:
lemma Tames.rescale_of_pos (h : ω.Tames J) {c : ℝ} (hcpos : 0 < c) :
    (ω.rescale c hcpos.ne').Tames J

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.tames_rescale_neg_iff_of_neg
decls.doc: Negative rescaling preserves and reflects tameness after replacing `J` by `-J`.
decls.statement:
lemma tames_rescale_neg_iff_of_neg {c : ℝ} (hcneg : c < 0) :
    (ω.rescale c hcneg.ne).Tames (-J) ↔ ω.Tames J

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames.rescale_neg_of_neg
decls.doc: Tameness is preserved by negative rescaling if the almost complex structure is negated too.
decls.statement:
lemma Tames.rescale_neg_of_neg (h : ω.Tames J) {c : ℝ} (hcneg : c < 0) :
    (ω.rescale c hcneg.ne).Tames (-J)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.compatible_rescale_iff_of_pos
decls.doc: Positive rescaling preserves and reflects compatibility.
decls.statement:
lemma compatible_rescale_iff_of_pos {c : ℝ} (hcpos : 0 < c) :
    (ω.rescale c hcpos.ne').Compatible J ↔ ω.Compatible J

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible.rescale_of_pos
decls.doc: Compatibility is preserved by positive rescaling of the symplectic form.
decls.statement:
lemma Compatible.rescale_of_pos (h : ω.Compatible J) {c : ℝ} (hcpos : 0 < c) :
    (ω.rescale c hcpos.ne').Compatible J

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.compatible_rescale_neg_iff_of_neg
decls.doc: Negative rescaling preserves and reflects compatibility after replacing `J` by `-J`.
decls.statement:
lemma compatible_rescale_neg_iff_of_neg {c : ℝ} (hcneg : c < 0) :
    (ω.rescale c hcneg.ne).Compatible (-J) ↔ ω.Compatible J

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible.rescale_neg_of_neg
decls.doc:
Compatibility is preserved by negative rescaling if the almost complex structure is negated
too.
decls.statement:
lemma Compatible.rescale_neg_of_neg (h : ω.Compatible J) {c : ℝ} (hcneg : c < 0) :
    (ω.rescale c hcneg.ne).Compatible (-J)

decls.name: TauCeti.stdSymplecticBilin
decls.doc:
The standard symplectic bilinear form on `V × V`, given by
`ω₀((x₁, y₁), (x₂, y₂)) = ⟪x₁, y₂⟫ - ⟪y₁, x₂⟫`.
decls.statement: def stdSymplecticBilin : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ (V × V)

decls.name: TauCeti.stdSymplecticBilin_apply
decls.statement:
lemma stdSymplecticBilin_apply (u w : V × V) :
    stdSymplecticBilin u w = ⟪u.1, w.2⟫_ℝ - ⟪u.2, w.1⟫_ℝ

decls.name: TauCeti.stdSymplecticBilin_isAlt
decls.statement: lemma stdSymplecticBilin_isAlt : (stdSymplecticBilin (V := V)).IsAlt

decls.name: TauCeti.stdSymplecticBilin_nondegenerate
decls.statement:
lemma stdSymplecticBilin_nondegenerate :
    (stdSymplecticBilin (V := V)).Nondegenerate

decls.name: TauCeti.stdSymplecticForm
decls.doc: The standard symplectic form `ω₀((x₁, y₁), (x₂, y₂)) = ⟪x₁, y₂⟫ - ⟪y₁, x₂⟫` on `V × V`.
decls.statement: def stdSymplecticForm : SymplecticForm (V × V)

decls.name: TauCeti.stdSymplecticForm_apply
decls.doc: The coordinate formula for evaluating the standard symplectic form on two vectors of `V × V`.
decls.statement:
lemma stdSymplecticForm_apply (u w : V × V) :
    stdSymplecticForm u w = ⟪u.1, w.2⟫_ℝ - ⟪u.2, w.1⟫_ℝ

decls.name: TauCeti.stdSymplecticForm_invariant_product
decls.doc: The standard symplectic form is invariant under the product almost complex structure.
decls.statement:
lemma stdSymplecticForm_invariant_product :
    (stdSymplecticForm (V := V)).Invariant (AlmostComplexStructure.product V)

decls.name: TauCeti.stdSymplecticForm_apply_product_self
decls.doc: `ω₀(v, J v) = ‖v.1‖² + ‖v.2‖²` for the product almost complex structure `J`.
decls.statement:
lemma stdSymplecticForm_apply_product_self (v : V × V) :
    stdSymplecticForm v (AlmostComplexStructure.product V v) = ⟪v.1, v.1⟫_ℝ + ⟪v.2, v.2⟫_ℝ

decls.name: TauCeti.stdSymplecticForm_tames_product
decls.doc: The standard symplectic form tames the product almost complex structure.
decls.statement:
lemma stdSymplecticForm_tames_product :
    (stdSymplecticForm (V := V)).Tames (AlmostComplexStructure.product V)

decls.name: TauCeti.stdSymplecticForm_compatible_product
decls.doc: The standard symplectic form is compatible with the product almost complex structure.
decls.statement:
lemma stdSymplecticForm_compatible_product :
    (stdSymplecticForm (V := V)).Compatible (AlmostComplexStructure.product V)

decls.name: TauCeti.stdSymplecticForm_associatedBilinForm_product
decls.doc:
The metric `g = ω₀(·, J ·)` associated to the standard compatible triple is the
componentwise inner product on `V × V`.
decls.statement:
lemma stdSymplecticForm_associatedBilinForm_product (u w : V × V) :
    (stdSymplecticForm (V := V)).associatedBilinForm (AlmostComplexStructure.product V) u w =
      ⟪u.1, w.1⟫_ℝ + ⟪u.2, w.2⟫_ℝ

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.transport
decls.doc:
Transport a symplectic form along a real-linear equivalence `e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W` by pushing the
arguments back along `e.symm`.

The underlying bilinear form is `LinearMap.BilinForm.congr e` applied to `ω`, equivalently
`(v, w) ↦ ω(e.symm v, e.symm w)`; it stays alternating and nondegenerate because `e.symm` is a
linear bijection.
decls.statement: def transport (ω : SymplecticForm V) (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) : SymplecticForm W

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.transport_toBilinForm
decls.statement:
lemma transport_toBilinForm (ω : SymplecticForm V) (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) :
    (ω.transport e).toBilinForm = LinearMap.BilinForm.congr e ω.toBilinForm

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.transport_apply
decls.statement:
lemma transport_apply (ω : SymplecticForm V) (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) (v w : W) :
    ω.transport e v w = ω (e.symm v) (e.symm w)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.transport_refl
decls.doc: Transporting along the identity equivalence does nothing.
decls.statement:
lemma transport_refl (ω : SymplecticForm V) :
    ω.transport (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ V) = ω

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.transport_trans
decls.doc:
Transport is functorial: transporting along `e₁` then `e₂` is transporting along their
composite.
decls.statement:
lemma transport_trans (ω : SymplecticForm V) (e₁ : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) (e₂ : W ≃ₗ[ℝ] X) :
    (ω.transport e₁).transport e₂ = ω.transport (e₁ ≪≫ₗ e₂)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.transport_symm_transport
decls.doc: Transporting forward along `e` and back along `e.symm` returns the original form.
decls.statement:
lemma transport_symm_transport (ω : SymplecticForm V) (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) :
    (ω.transport e).transport e.symm = ω

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.transport_transport_symm
decls.doc: Transporting back along `e.symm` and forward along `e` returns the original form.
decls.statement:
lemma transport_transport_symm (ω : SymplecticForm W) (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) :
    (ω.transport e.symm).transport e = ω

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.transport_apply_apply
decls.doc:
`e` is a symplectomorphism onto the transported form: evaluating `ω.transport e` on images
under `e` recovers `ω`.
decls.statement:
lemma transport_apply_apply (ω : SymplecticForm V) (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) (v w : V) :
    ω.transport e (e v) (e w) = ω v w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsSymplectomorphism
decls.doc:
A real-linear equivalence `e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W` is a symplectomorphism from `(V, ω₁)` to `(W, ω₂)`
when it intertwines the two symplectic forms, `ω₂(e v, e w) = ω₁(v, w)`.

The body is `@[no_expose]`: downstream code uses this predicate through `isSymplectomorphism_iff`,
`IsSymplectomorphism.apply`, and `isSymplectomorphism_iff_transport_eq` rather than by unfolding.
decls.statement:
def IsSymplectomorphism (ω₁ : SymplecticForm V) (ω₂ : SymplecticForm W) (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) :
    Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isSymplectomorphism_iff
decls.doc:
A linear equivalence is a symplectomorphism exactly when it preserves the symplectic forms
pointwise.
decls.statement:
lemma isSymplectomorphism_iff {e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W} :
    IsSymplectomorphism ω₁ ω₂ e ↔ ∀ v w, ω₂ (e v) (e w) = ω₁ v w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsSymplectomorphism.apply
decls.doc: Apply a symplectomorphism hypothesis to two vectors.
decls.statement:
lemma IsSymplectomorphism.apply {e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W} (h : IsSymplectomorphism ω₁ ω₂ e) (v w : V) :
    ω₂ (e v) (e w) = ω₁ v w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.isSymplectomorphism_iff_transport_eq
decls.doc:
A linear equivalence is a symplectomorphism exactly when `ω₂` is the transport of `ω₁`
along that equivalence.
decls.statement:
lemma isSymplectomorphism_iff_transport_eq {e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W} :
    IsSymplectomorphism ω₁ ω₂ e ↔ ω₁.transport e = ω₂

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsSymplectomorphism.refl
decls.doc: The identity equivalence is a symplectomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma IsSymplectomorphism.refl (ω : SymplecticForm V) :
    IsSymplectomorphism ω ω (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ V)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsSymplectomorphism.symm
decls.doc: The inverse of a symplectomorphism is a symplectomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma IsSymplectomorphism.symm {e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W} (h : IsSymplectomorphism ω₁ ω₂ e) :
    IsSymplectomorphism ω₂ ω₁ e.symm

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.IsSymplectomorphism.trans
decls.doc: Symplectomorphisms compose.

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.invariant_transport_iff
decls.doc: Transport by a linear equivalence preserves and reflects `J`-invariance.
decls.statement:
lemma invariant_transport_iff (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V)
    (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) : (ω.transport e).Invariant (J.transport e) ↔ ω.Invariant J

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Invariant.transport
decls.doc:
`J`-invariance transports along a linear equivalence: if `ω` is `J`-invariant, then
`ω.transport e` is invariant under the transported almost complex structure `J.transport e`.
decls.statement:
lemma Invariant.transport (hinv : ω.Invariant J) (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) :
    (ω.transport e).Invariant (J.transport e)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.tames_transport_iff
decls.doc: Transport by a linear equivalence preserves and reflects tameness.
decls.statement:
lemma tames_transport_iff (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V)
    (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) : (ω.transport e).Tames (J.transport e) ↔ ω.Tames J

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames.transport
decls.doc:
Taming transports along a linear equivalence: if `ω` tames `J`, then `ω.transport e` tames
the transported almost complex structure `J.transport e`.
decls.statement:
lemma Tames.transport (htames : ω.Tames J) (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) :
    (ω.transport e).Tames (J.transport e)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.compatible_transport_iff
decls.doc: Transport by a linear equivalence preserves and reflects compatibility.
decls.statement:
lemma compatible_transport_iff (ω : SymplecticForm V) (J : AlmostComplexStructure V)
    (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) : (ω.transport e).Compatible (J.transport e) ↔ ω.Compatible J

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible.transport
decls.doc:
Compatibility transports along a linear equivalence: if `ω` is compatible with `J`, then
`ω.transport e` is compatible with the transported almost complex structure `J.transport e`. This
expresses that `e` carries the compatible pair `(ω, J)` to the compatible pair
`(ω.transport e, J.transport e)`.
decls.statement:
lemma Compatible.transport (h : ω.Compatible J) (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) :
    (ω.transport e).Compatible (J.transport e)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.symmetrizedBilinForm
decls.statement: def symmetrizedBilinForm : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ V

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.symmetrizedBilinForm_apply
decls.statement:
lemma symmetrizedBilinForm_apply (v w : V) :
    ω.symmetrizedBilinForm J v w = ω v (J w) + ω w (J v)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.symmetrizedBilinForm_isSymm
decls.doc: The symmetric part of the metric is symmetric, for any almost complex structure.
decls.statement: lemma symmetrizedBilinForm_isSymm : (ω.symmetrizedBilinForm J).IsSymm

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.symmetrizedBilinForm_invariant
decls.doc:
The symmetric part of the metric is `J`-invariant, for any symplectic form: `gₛ(J v, J w) =
gₛ(v, w)`. This uses only `J² = -1` and skew-symmetry of `ω`, not taming.
decls.statement:
lemma symmetrizedBilinForm_invariant (v w : V) :
    ω.symmetrizedBilinForm J (J v) (J w) = ω.symmetrizedBilinForm J v w

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.symmetrizedBilinForm_apply_self
decls.doc: The diagonal of the symmetric part is twice the symplectic diagonal: `gₛ(v, v) = 2 ω(v, Jv)`.
decls.statement:
lemma symmetrizedBilinForm_apply_self (v : V) :
    ω.symmetrizedBilinForm J v v = 2 * ω v (J v)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames.symplecticForm_apply_apply_self_nonneg
decls.doc: The symplectic diagonal `ω(v, J v)` is nonnegative under taming.
decls.statement: lemma symplecticForm_apply_apply_self_nonneg (h : ω.Tames J) (v : V) : 0 ≤ ω v (J v)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames.symmetrizedBilinForm_self_pos
decls.doc: The diagonal of the symmetric part is positive on nonzero vectors.
decls.statement:
lemma symmetrizedBilinForm_self_pos (h : ω.Tames J) {v : V} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    0 < ω.symmetrizedBilinForm J v v

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames.symmetrizedBilinForm_self_nonneg
decls.doc: The diagonal of the symmetric part is nonnegative.
decls.statement:
lemma symmetrizedBilinForm_self_nonneg (h : ω.Tames J) (v : V) :
    0 ≤ ω.symmetrizedBilinForm J v v

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames.symmetrizedBilinForm_posDef
decls.doc: Under taming, the symmetric part of the metric is positive definite.
decls.statement:
lemma symmetrizedBilinForm_posDef (h : ω.Tames J) :
    (ω.symmetrizedBilinForm J).toQuadraticMap.PosDef

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames.symmetrizedBilinForm_self_eq_zero
decls.doc: The diagonal of the symmetric part detects zero vectors.
decls.statement:
lemma symmetrizedBilinForm_self_eq_zero (h : ω.Tames J) {v : V} :
    ω.symmetrizedBilinForm J v v = 0 ↔ v = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames.symmetrizedBilinForm_nondegenerate
decls.doc: The symmetric part of the metric of a tame pair is nondegenerate.
decls.statement:
lemma symmetrizedBilinForm_nondegenerate (h : ω.Tames J) :
    (ω.symmetrizedBilinForm J).Nondegenerate

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames.innerProductCore
decls.doc:
The symmetric part of the metric of a tame pair, packaged as an `InnerProductSpace.Core ℝ V`.

The inner product is `⟪v, w⟫ = ω(v, J w) + ω(w, J v)`, the symmetric part of `ω(·, J ·)`.
decls.statement: def innerProductCore (h : ω.Tames J) : InnerProductSpace.Core ℝ V

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames.innerProductCore_inner
decls.doc: The inner product from `innerProductCore` is the symmetric part `ω(v, J w) + ω(w, J v)`.
decls.statement:
lemma innerProductCore_inner (h : ω.Tames J) (v w : V) :
    @inner ℝ V h.innerProductCore.toInner v w = ω v (J w) + ω w (J v)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Tames.innerProductCore_inner_invariant
decls.doc: The inner product from `innerProductCore` is `J`-invariant: `⟪J v, J w⟫ = ⟪v, w⟫`.

decls.name: TauCeti.SymplecticForm.Compatible.symmetrizedBilinForm_apply
decls.doc:
When `ω` is compatible with `J`, its asymmetric metric `ω(·, J ·)` is already symmetric, so
the symmetric part is just twice it: `gₛ(v, w) = 2 ω(v, J w)`.
decls.statement:
lemma symmetrizedBilinForm_apply (h : ω.Compatible J) (v w : V) :
    ω.symmetrizedBilinForm J v w = 2 * ω v (J w)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.product_toLinearMap_eq_skewSwap
decls.doc:
The standard product almost complex structure on `V × V` is the `skewSwap` doubled-module
complex structure: both send `(x, y)` to `(-y, x)`.
decls.statement:
theorem product_toLinearMap_eq_skewSwap :
    (product V).toLinearMap = (LinearEquiv.skewSwap ℝ V V).toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Submodule.isMaximalTotallyReal_prod_top_bot_product
decls.doc:
The first factor in `V × V` is maximal totally real for the standard product almost complex
structure.
decls.statement:
theorem isMaximalTotallyReal_prod_top_bot_product :
    IsMaximalTotallyReal (AlmostComplexStructure.product V).toLinearMap
      ((⊤ : Submodule ℝ V).prod (⊥ : Submodule ℝ V))

decls.name: TauCeti.Submodule.isMaximalTotallyReal_prod_bot_top_product
decls.doc:
The second factor in `V × V` is maximal totally real for the standard product almost complex
structure.
decls.statement:
theorem isMaximalTotallyReal_prod_bot_top_product :
    IsMaximalTotallyReal (AlmostComplexStructure.product V).toLinearMap
      ((⊥ : Submodule ℝ V).prod (⊤ : Submodule ℝ V))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.transport
decls.doc:
Transport an almost complex structure along a real-linear equivalence by conjugation.

The transported endomorphism is `LinearEquiv.conj e` applied to `J`, equivalently
`w ↦ e (J (e.symm w))`, and it satisfies the almost-complex square condition.
decls.statement: def transport (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) : AlmostComplexStructure W

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.transport_toLinearMap
decls.statement:
lemma transport_toLinearMap (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) :
    (J.transport e).toLinearMap = e.conj J.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.transport_apply
decls.statement:
lemma transport_apply (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) (w : W) :
    J.transport e w = e (J (e.symm w))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.transport_refl
decls.doc: Transporting along the identity equivalence does nothing.
decls.statement:
lemma transport_refl (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) :
    J.transport (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ V) = J

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.transport_trans
decls.doc:
Transport is functorial: transporting along `e₁` then `e₂` is transporting along their
composite.
decls.statement:
lemma transport_trans (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) (e₁ : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) (e₂ : W ≃ₗ[ℝ] X) :
    (J.transport e₁).transport e₂ = J.transport (e₁ ≪≫ₗ e₂)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.transport_symm_transport
decls.doc: Transporting forward along `e` and back along `e.symm` returns the original structure.
decls.statement:
lemma transport_symm_transport (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) :
    (J.transport e).transport e.symm = J

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.transport_transport_symm
decls.doc: Transporting back along `e.symm` and forward along `e` returns the original structure.
decls.statement:
lemma transport_transport_symm (J : AlmostComplexStructure W) (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) :
    (J.transport e.symm).transport e = J

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.transport_neg
decls.doc: Transport commutes with negation of the almost complex structure.
decls.statement:
lemma transport_neg (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) :
    (-J).transport e = -(J.transport e)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.isComplexLinearMap_transport
decls.doc: A linear equivalence is complex-linear from `J` to its transport `J.transport e`.
decls.statement:
lemma isComplexLinearMap_transport (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) :
    IsComplexLinearMap J (J.transport e) e.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.isComplexLinearMap_symm_transport
decls.doc: The inverse equivalence is complex-linear from `J.transport e` back to `J`.
decls.statement:
lemma isComplexLinearMap_symm_transport (J : AlmostComplexStructure V) (e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) :
    IsComplexLinearMap (J.transport e) J e.symm.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.isComplexLinearMap_arrowCongr_iff
decls.doc:
Complex-linearity is preserved and reflected when source, target, and map are transported
along linear equivalences.

decls.name: TauCeti.IsComplexLinearMap.arrowCongr
decls.doc:
Complex-linearity transports along a pair of linear equivalences: if `F` intertwines `J`
and `J'`, then conjugating `F` by `eV` on the source and `eW` on the target intertwines the
transported structures.
decls.statement:
lemma IsComplexLinearMap.arrowCongr {J : AlmostComplexStructure V₁}
    {J' : AlmostComplexStructure W₁} {F : V₁ →ₗ[ℝ] W₁} (hF : IsComplexLinearMap J J' F)
    (eV : V₁ ≃ₗ[ℝ] V₂) (eW : W₁ ≃ₗ[ℝ] W₂) :
    IsComplexLinearMap (J.transport eV) (J'.transport eW) (eV.arrowCongr eW F)
